About Foresters Financial


At Foresters Financial, we are more than a financial services company. As a purpose driven fraternal benefit society, everything we do is built around helping families and communities thrive. That purpose is not a tagline. It shows up in the work: building playgrounds in the communities we serve, the volunteer days our people take, and member benefits that reach far beyond a policy. We invest in inclusion, diversity and well-being, and we invest just as seriously in the growth of our people. When you join Foresters, you join a culture that genuinely lives what it stands for.

As a Service Center Representative, you’ll be a trusted point of contact for members, customers, and their representatives. You’ll provide guidance and support related to insurance products and services, helping customers understand their options and navigate their needs with confidence.

Using empathy, active listening, and strong problem-solving skills, you’ll deliver a positive customer experience across phone, email, and chat while contributing to Foresters’ commitment to making it easy to do business with us.

Job Description

What your day will look like

This is a fully remote, omnichannel role with a strong focus on inbound phone support. You’ll spend most of your day assisting customers by phone, while also responding to email and chat inquiries based on business needs.

No two interactions are the same. You may answer questions about insurance coverage, explain policy terminology, process policy changes, assist with billing and payment inquiries, troubleshoot online account access, or support customers experiencing difficult life events.

Throughout the day, you’ll navigate multiple systems to access and update customer information, document interactions accurately, complete required processing, and ensure requests are handled efficiently. Some inquiries can be resolved during the first interaction, while others may require research or coordination with internal teams.

You’ll work within a scheduled shift and receive comprehensive training, ongoing coaching, established procedures, and support from experienced colleagues to help you build your knowledge and succeed in a fast-paced service environment.


What you will do

  • Deliver caring, accurate, and responsive support across phone, email, and chat, working toward first-contact resolution whenever possible.
  • Analyze and resolve inquiries involving insurance coverage, policies, billing, payments, complaints, and online tools.
  • Complete policy updates, payment-related activities, documentation, data entry, CRM maintenance, and required customer follow-up.
  • Help customers understand their options and confidently use available online and self-service tools.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve complex matters, support customer retention, and improve the customer experience.
  • Maintain current knowledge and meet established expectations for customer satisfaction, service quality, accuracy, productivity, operational performance, and schedule adherence.
  • Contribute to team discussions, continuous improvement initiatives, and the training or mentoring of new team members when required.

What you will bring

  • 3–5 years of customer service experience, with a demonstrated commitment to service excellence. Experience in an inbound contact center and/or financial services environment is considered an asset.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume phone environment, including meeting KPI targets and working within call monitoring expectations.
  • Ability to manage complex and sensitive customer situations with empathy, professionalism, patience, sound judgment, and flexibility, particularly when supporting individuals experiencing grief or distress.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain insurance terms and concepts clearly to customers from diverse backgrounds, including those experiencing heightened emotions following a loss.
  • Strong computer proficiency, with the ability to navigate multiple systems simultaneously, including CRM platforms, customer service software, and online self-service tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to troubleshoot issues, navigate systems effectively, and quickly learn new technology.
  • Experience supporting data entry, payment processing, customer retention, and customer education activities.
  • Strong problem-solving, resourcefulness, attention to detail, multitasking, and time management skills, with the ability to remain adaptable as priorities evolve.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced remote service environment, including phone-based customer support.
  • Knowledge of insurance products, regulatory requirements, and contact centre KPIs is considered an asset.
  • A college diploma or university degree is considered an asset; bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish or French is considered an asset;
  • Flexibility to work within operating hours, which may include scheduled evening shifts, overtime, and statutory holidays based on business needs.

Salary Range:

$44,000.00 - $57,000.00

  • Must be available to work rotating shifts between the hours of 9:00am and 6:30pm, Monday to Friday, occasional Overtime and provide coverage on some Canadian Statutory holidays
  • Our office is located at Eglinton and Don Mills

The actual base salary for this position will depend on several factors, including job-related skills, experience, and education. In addition to base pay, eligible employees may participate in a discretionary variable incentive plan, results are subject to both individual and company performance.


Please note that this posting is intended to fill an existing vacancy; however, there may be instances where more than one vacancy is available for the same role.


This organization may use artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support initial applicant screening and assessment. AI may evaluate application materials against job-related criteria.


What’s in it for you


Some benefits may apply to regular or full-time employees only.


  • Health, dental and well-being coverage. Coverage and programs that supports you and your family on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement and pension with matching contributions. We invest in your long-term stability, because longevity and supporting your family matter.
  • Meaningful vacation time. Paid vacation time off, and a culture that encourages you to take time and recharge.
  • Your growth matters. We support your career goals with learning opportunities, industry credentials like LOMA, and development experiences designed to help you build skills for your future.
  • Membership advantages. Be an ambassador and get the benefits. If you join Foresters as a policy holder, you become a member, which opens the door to member benefits.
  • Volunteering with purpose. Paid day for volunteering, and ample opportunity to make a difference in your community.
  • Employee Resource Groups. Join our ERG groups for opportunities to connect, grow and make an impact through shared experience, networking, mentorship and education

How we work


This is a remote role. You must work in the province in which you reside.


As you grow your career with Foresters, you may explore opportunities across different teams and areas of the organization. Work arrangements vary by role, and many positions follow a hybrid model that includes time in the office.


Our Commitment to Inclusion, Diversity & Wellbeing


At Foresters, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive workplace where employees feel they belong and can thrive. Guided by our Purpose of enriching the wellbeing of families and communities, we foster a culture that values different perspectives, supports wellbeing, and provides fair opportunities for growth and success.


Foresters welcomes applications from qualified individuals of all backgrounds. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact .


Thank you for choosing Foresters. Only those candidates who will be selected for further consideration will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Team.

Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

As a dedicated Director, Product Management you will manage a team of individual contributors responsible for formulating product/sales strategy recommendations based on analysis of profitability, competitiveness and sales performance for the product life cycle. Compile, analyze and interpret data to make strategic and tactical recommendations or decisions pertaining to sales/product performance. Be responsible for defining the business questions and providing insights to improve business performance. Support the maintenance of existing products and/or may lead in the development and launch of less complex, new products with channel partners managing and prioritizing deliverables in accordance with Agile principles.


What you'll do:

  • Responsible for communicating and promoting the product value proposition to Distribution organization.
  • Ensure product team delivers sales support to all distribution channels (e.g., .com, mobile, contact center) so that the product is properly positioned to customers (sales tool and collateral development, sales training, etc.).
  • Develop new product or sales offerings and enhanced features/services to existing product or sales offerings utilizing Agile methodologies to deliver innovative solutions.
  • Lead research, analysis and evaluates performance metrics to drive recommendations for market opportunities or product enhancements.

Description

TripleTenis an award-winning online school among technology bootcamps. Our mission is to help people change their lives and succeed in technology. We offer flexibility in studies, career mentoring, resume and portfolio preparation, and we guarantee employment after the course. Our employability rate among graduates is 87% across our Full Stack Development, Quality Assurance (QA) and Data Analytics.

We are now looking for a Customer Reputation Specialist to join our LATAM team!

This role focuses on managing, de-escalating, and resolving critical and high-friction student issues across the LATAM market. You will be responsible for handling sensitive student cases, mitigating reputational and legal risks, and negotiating effective solutions while ensuring an empathetic and positive student experience.

Your main goal will be to protect the company's reputation, prevent further escalation, and reach fair and effective resolutions for students and the business.

Please submit your updated resume or CV in English.

What you will do

As a Customer Reputation Specialist, you will be responsible for managing complex student complaints and high-risk cases, communicating directly with students, and coordinating with internal teams to achieve timely and effective resolutions.

Main responsibilities will include:

  • Case Analysis: Thoroughly investigate escalated cases, understanding the context, background, and specific circumstances of each student complaint.
  • Student Communication & De-escalation: Contact students directly through calls and written channels, build rapport, actively listen to their concerns, and de-escalate high-friction situations.
  • Conflict Resolution & Negotiation: Negotiate and mediate agreements with students, aiming to reach mutually acceptable solutions and prevent further escalation, including legal claims, formal complaints, or negative social media exposure.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential reputational, legal, and business risks and take appropriate action to minimize their impact.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams to investigate cases, align on solutions, and ensure timely resolution in accordance with company policies.
  • Documentation & Follow-up: Maintain accurate records of case progress, agreements, communications, and outcomes, ensuring proper follow-up until resolution.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in customer service, customer retention, escalations, complaints management, or high-touch customer support roles.
  • Proven experience handling difficult customers, high-conflict situations, sensitive complaints, and complex customer escalations.
  • Experience managing sensitive cases involving potential legal action, formal complaints, legal claims, or reputational risks.
  • Familiarity with handling public customer complaints, social media escalations, and situations involving threats of negative brand exposure.
  • Outstanding active listening and communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive and difficult conversations.
  • Exceptional empathy and emotional intelligence, combined with the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Spanish.
  • Proficiency in English for written and verbal communication.
  • Experience using Slack, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, and Google Workspace.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple complex cases simultaneously.
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and strong judgment when identifying and managing high-pressure, legal, and reputational risk situations.

What we can offer you

  • 100% remote work.
  • 600 USD gross per month + monthly bonuses based on KPI results.
  • Full-time role, Monday to Friday. Schedule from 9am to 19pm Mex time UTC -6 (1 hour for lunch)
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Slack, Jira, HubSpot, Notion, etc. — to make the working together process seamless.
  • A diverse and tight-knit team, spread out across the US, LatAm, and more!

raw.description:
Founded by Arianna Huffington in 2016, Thrive Global is a leading behavior change technology company with the mission to improve productivity and health outcomes – one Microstep at a time. Thrive helps individuals and organizations improve well-being, performance and mental resilience with its AI-powered behavior change technology platform. Thrive’s Microsteps – small, science-backed steps to improve health and productivity – have been adopted by employees at more than 230 organizations in over 160 countries, from frontline and call center workers to executives at multinational companies. For more information, visitwww.thriveglobal.com.

The Account Executive, Strategic Health Partnerships is a quota-carrying, fully sales-focused role responsible for winning new pharmaceutical, life sciences, and healthcare customers.Thrive Global helps pharma partners combine breakthrough medicines and Thrive’s science-backed behavior change methodology to support patients across their health journey, whether managing a disease state, participating in a clinical trial, or simply trying to increase longevity and quality of life. The role owns the sales cycle from first conversation to close, with a primary focus on new logos and additional responsibility for expansion in signed accounts.

This is a builder role. The Account Executive works opportunities from senior leadership and assigned accounts, and also generates new pipeline through their own network and market intelligence. Reporting to the VP, Sales & Partnerships, and supported by the GTM Strategy team, the Account Executive works closely with Product, Content, Legal, and Executive Leadership. After close, the Account Executive ensures a smooth and effective hand-off to Customer Success ensuring optimal customer experience.

How You'll Contribute

  • Turn opportunities from senior leadership into qualified deals, and create new pipeline through your network, outreach, and market intelligence (such as loss of exclusivity, launches, and competitive pressure).
  • Research and prioritize target companies by therapeutic area, portfolio, and market dynamics.
  • Position patient engagement, patient support, clinical trial engagement and retention, and communications solutions, along with the broader Thrive platform.
  • Build relationships across pharma prospects, from patient engagement, clinical, commercial, and direct-to-consumer site leaders up to the C-suite, and identify the economic buyer and champion early.
  • Identify and close projects and expansion opportunities in signed accounts, working alongside Customer Success.
  • Develop proposals, pilots, and commercial structures with Product, Content, and Finance, tied to outcomes such as adherence, engagement, retention, and brand trust.
  • Work with Legal and the customer’s MLR, compliance, privacy, and procurement teams through contracting and review.
  • Use AI tools to prepare account research, tailor outreach to each buyer, and keep Salesforce current, applying your own judgment and never putting patient or sensitive data into tools that aren’t approved for it.
  • Raise deal risks early with a recommended path forward, and represent Thrive at industry events and customer meetings
  • Therapeutic areas Thrive supports today include oncology, obesity, diabetes, migraine, sleep apnea, schizophrenia, women’s health, chronic pain, autoimmune conditions, cardiovascular, dermatology, and brain health.
  • Travel is expected to be approximately 25%.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience in pharma, life sciences, or health technology, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota in long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
  • Pharma experience is ideal, but strong health tech backgrounds are welcome.
  • A proven ability to generate your own pipeline, with an existing network in pharma, life sciences, or health tech.
  • Experience selling to senior stakeholders; C-suite experience is a plus but not required.
  • Familiarity with patient engagement, patient support, clinical trial, or direct-to-consumer functions at pharma companies.
  • Working knowledge of pharma compliance and regulatory review (such as MLR and privacy).
  • Strong research and structured-thinking skills, with the ability to turn market insight into a clear business case.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, G-Suite, and Microsoft products.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate and optimize sales processes using leading AI tools, principally Claude AI.
  • Passion for Thrive’s mission of science-backed behavior change.

✨ What We Offer:

  • 🌍 Mission-Driven Impact: Be part of a company that’s truly making a difference in people’s lives around the world.
  • 🚀 Career Growth: Develop within the company and help shape our growth strategy.
  • 💙 Human-Centric Culture: Thrive in a supportive environment with a range of wellness perks and benefits.
  • 💰 Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a comprehensive and rewarding total compensation package.
  • 🩺 Health & Financial Benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage plus a 401(k) program with company match.
  • 🌴 Time to Recharge: Generous paid time-off programs designed to help you rest, reset, and recharge — including Thrive Time, a benefit unique to Thrive that gives employees additional paid time off after major projects or intense periods of work to truly recharge and recover.

Compensation:

On target total earnings for this role will likely fall in the $300,000-$400,000 range.

  • Please note: We provide a competitive mix of salary, performance bonus, and equity. The final offer amount will depend on factors like experience, expertise, and may differ from the range above. This range also excludes additional benefits, such as 401(k), and medical, dental, or vision insurance.

About the role

ACME Corporation is seeking an exceptionally driven, endlessly resourceful, and moderately indestructible Senior Roadrunner Acquisition Specialist to lead our primary wildlife pursuit initiatives within the Desert Operations Division. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, you will take full ownership of experimental mechanical systems, kinetic deployments, and strategic planning targeting a notoriously elusive Greater Roadrunner (Geococcyx californianus). This is a full-time, permanent position operated under a remote work policy in the American Southwest (preferably near a suspiciously straight stretch of highway).

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Pursuit & Target Acquisition: Develop and execute multi-phase capture strategies based on detailed behavioral tracking, dietary preferences, and apparent immunity to standard physical laws.
  • Experimental Engineering & Prototyping: Design, fabricate, and field-test custom kinetic systems incorporating rocket propulsion arrays, spring-loaded platforms, oversized magnets, giant slingshots, and gravity-assisted acceleration.
  • Ambush Architecture: Design and deploy elaborate ambushes involving tunnels, cliffs, strategically placed birdseed, unattended boxes, and two-dimensional painted landscape illusions (trompe-l'œil).
  • Failure Analysis & Rapid Iteration: Perform blameless root-cause analyses following catastrophic failures (preferably after regaining consciousness) to document lessons learned and iterate on mechanical reliability.
  • Operational Safety & Risk Management: Manage the end-to-end deployment of industrial explosives, pyrotechnics, anvils, rolling boulders, and high-tensile adhesives.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Convey complex technical concepts through detailed diagrams, expressive facial gestures, and strategically positioned handwritten signs.

Required Qualifications

  • Technical Expertise: PhD-level understanding of mechanical engineering, physics, classical mechanics, or rocketry (demonstrated genius preferred over formal credentials).
  • Relevant Experience: 10+ years in pursuit operations, experimental systems engineering, or repeated unsuccessful attempts to achieve a clearly defined objective.
  • Durability & Resilience: Extraordinary physical durability, high tolerance for blunt-force trauma, and proven ability to remain motivated following hundreds of consecutive failures.
  • Communication: Strong written communication skills (verbal communication is considered unnecessary).

What ACME Offers

  • Unlimited R&D budget: Access to an extensive catalog of experimental equipment without procurement oversight.
  • Flexible working hours: Pursue your target whenever inspiration strikes or the Roadrunner appears.
  • Antifragile culture: High autonomy, no micromanagement, unlimited recovery time, and generous performance bonuses upon successful acquisition.

raw.description:
About Offprem Technology

Offprem Technology is a Salesforce Summit Partner and Claude Certified firm, with consultants certified in both. We help organizations across industries implement, run, and get more from Salesforce and Claude, together or on their own, and we use Claude in our own delivery. Starting fresh or already live, our clients work with people who guide every decision.

We stay close to what Salesforce is shipping, from Agentforce and Data 360 to Marketing Cloud Next, so our recommendations reflect what the platform can do today. We build around your CRM, connecting marketing, sales, and service data so AI and automation work from a single view of the customer.

We’re headquartered in Indiana, remote friendly, and hire across the United States. Whether you’re an experienced consultant or want to deepen your expertise in Salesforce’s marketing and AI platforms, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Consultant to support a high-volume JumpStart delivery model in the small to medium business space.

If you're familiar with Salesforce JumpStarts you know that this work is limited engagement implementations focused on getting clients up and running quickly using out-of-the-box configuration, best practices, and standard functionality. No heavy customization, no complex development. Discovery, configuration, data import, user setup, and training. Clean, repeatable, time-boxed projects. Many times this kind of project is an entry point to longer term relationships, as such your client facing experience is paramount.

What you'll do:

Deliver Salesforce JumpStart implementations from kickoff through handoff. This includes requirements discovery, out-of-the-box org configuration, basic data migration, user setup and permissions, and end-user training.

Additionally, the Consultant will lead Salesforce Kickstart and rapid-delivery engagements, owning solution design, configuration, and client guidance for fixed-scope implementations across core Salesforce clouds. This role partners closely with clients to translate defined business requirements into best-practice Salesforce solutions, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently, on time, and aligned to Salesforce standards. The ideal candidate is hands-on, delivery-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple short-cycle projects concurrently.

Requirements:

  • 6-12 months of Salesforce solution design and delivery experience, preferably in a consulting or partner environment
  • Hands-on experience implementing Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud (additional clouds a plus)
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, security, and standard automation tools (Flows, validation rules, approvals)
  • Experience delivering fixed-scope or rapid implementation, JumpStart or similar limited-engagement implementations using Salesforce best practices
  • Ability to run discovery sessions, document requirements, and translate them into scalable configurations
  • Experience supporting data imports, basic integrations, and go-live readiness including deployment best practices

Overview

Lumicera Health Services is seeking a Wholesaler Relations & Contracting Manager to join our team!

The Wholesaler Relations & Contracting Manager develops and manages strategic relationships with pharmaceutical wholesalers and distribution partners to expand channel opportunities and create value for Clarventa and its GPO member pharmacies. This role leads wholesaler contracting activities, supports the development of new distribution opportunities, and helps translate Clarventa’s aggregated member demand into mutually beneficial commercial partnerships. The Manager serves as a key relationship lead across primary, secondary, and tertiary wholesaler channels, working directly with partners to negotiate and implement agreements, grow network participation and purchasing volume, and identify new opportunities for collaboration.

The Wholesaler Relations & Contracting Manager remains actively engaged after implementation to support contract performance, resolve issues, and strengthen long-term partner relationships. This highly collaborative, external-facing role requires an understanding of pharmaceutical distribution and the ability to work across relationship management, business development, contracting, and execution. The Manager works closely with Clarventa leadership and cross-functional teams to advance opportunities from initial discussion through contracting, implementation, and ongoing performance management.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Represent Clarventa in the market as a relationship and contracting lead for pharmaceutical wholesalers and distribution partners.
  • Develop and maintain strategic relationships across primary, secondary, and tertiary wholesaler channels, serving as a key day-to-day contact for assigned partners.
  • Identify and develop new channel, distribution, and network access opportunities that create value for wholesaler partners and Clarventa member pharmacies.
  • Lead and support commercial negotiations with wholesalers and distribution partners to secure competitive pricing, favorable terms, sustainable economics, and measurable member value.
  • Develop partner strategies and action plans that expand participation, purchasing volume, contract utilization, and long-term engagement across the Clarventa network.
  • Convert partnership opportunities into signed, executable agreements and coordinate with internal stakeholders through contracting, implementation, and launch.
  • Understand wholesaler business needs and effectively position Clarventa’s network, aggregated demand, reporting capabilities, and partnership model to external stakeholders.
  • Monitor purchasing activity, participation trends, reporting, and partner performance to identify growth opportunities, risks, and areas requiring action.
  • Partner with analytics and operations teams to provide performance visibility and actionable insights that support partner decision-making and network growth.
  • Facilitate communication among wholesalers, member pharmacies, manufacturers, and internal stakeholders to resolve contracting, eligibility, reporting, operational, and relationship issues.
  • Support contract awareness, network engagement, and ongoing relationship management after implementation to help agreements become active, productive partnerships.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of wholesaler opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic initiatives, with clear ownership of next steps and outcomes.
  • Ensure wholesaler and distribution agreements align with applicable legal, regulatory, and industry standards.
  • Travel up to 15% of the time to support partner meetings, industry events, and business needs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required. MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in pharmaceutical distribution, specialty pharmacy, pharmacy GPOs, or related healthcare commercial roles required.
  • Experience managing wholesaler relationships and supporting commercial contracting, business development, or strategic partnerships required.
  • Working knowledge of pharmaceutical distribution channels, including primary, secondary, and tertiary wholesalers, required.
  • Experience identifying new channel opportunities and negotiating commercial agreements with wholesalers, distributors, pharmacies, manufacturers, or other healthcare organizations preferred.

raw.description:
Job Summary:

The Regional Accountant makes sure every entity in the region reports complete, accurate and compliant results before they roll up to the portfolio.

The role is the portfolio's finance link to the region's Business Units (BU). It reviews close deliverables, investigates variances, reconciles intercompany balances, and oversees local tax obligations. It gives the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager a single, reliable point of contact and early warning of issues for each region.

Job Description:

Key responsibilities


1. Regional point of contact

  • Act as the primary point of contact between the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager and the BUs in the region.
  • Communicate portfolio reporting timetables, templates and requirements to BU finance teams, and follow up on outstanding deliverables.
  • Build working relationships with BU finance staff so issues surface early.

2. Period-end review

  • Review month-end, quarter-end and year-end results and close deliverables for entities in the region.
  • Confirm completeness, accuracy and consistency with portfolio policies before results roll up to the portfolio.
  • Track open review points with BUs through to resolution within the close timetable.

3. Variance and balance analysis

  • Investigate unusual entity-level variances and balances to confirm the accuracy of reported results.
  • Obtain explanations and supporting evidence from BUs where movements are not self-evident.
  • Flag issues, potential misstatements and judgement areas to the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager and Sub-Portfolio Finance Lead.

4. Tax compliance

  • Review and support BUs to ensure tax compliance for entities in the region, including indirect taxes (GST, VAT, US sales tax) and income tax returns.
  • Support BUs working with external tax advisors on preparation, review and lodgment of returns, and respond to their information requests.
  • Maintain a regional tax compliance calendar so filing deadlines are met.

5. Intercompany reconciliation

  • Ensure intercompany balances reconcile for entities in the region each period.
  • Investigate and resolve mismatches with counterparty entities, including those in other regions.
  • Escalate unresolved differences before consolidation deadlines.

6. Regulatory awareness

  • Maintain knowledge of local accounting, tax and regulatory requirements in the region.
  • Flag changes to the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager and the Director of GRC, with an initial view of the impact.

7. Reconciliation review (OneStream)

  • Review OneStream reconciliations to confirm work papers and supporting documentation match the balance sheet.
  • Report any concerns or discrepancies to the Portfolio Reporting Consolidation Manager, copying the relevant Sub-Portfolio Finance Leads.

8. Other

  • Support portfolio projects such as system implementations, acquisition onboarding and process improvement, as directed.
  • Perform other duties consistent with the role, as reasonably required.

Worker Type:

Regular

Number of Openings Available:

1

At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.

**Travel to Office expectations**

For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.

The Role

Reporting to the Vice President, Advanced Technology, you will be a member of the Advanced Technology / Applied AI Research team at PointClickCare.
You are a talented Senior Applied Researcher in AI / Machine Learning, looking to make a difference solving critical customer and business challenges in the dynamic healthcare market. You thrive applying creative and pragmatic solutions—from framing problems and preparing data, to selecting appropriate techniques, building and evaluating model systems—that will truly transform healthcare and enable our customers to deliver exceptional care.

Responsibilities

  • Apply machine learning and AI techniques including GenAI and LLM-based approaches to develop model systems and solutions, collaborating across functions to scale and integrate these into large-scale cloud-based SaaS production environments for healthcare.
  • Work with product leaders, clinical informaticists, data scientists, UI/UX researchers, engineers, and healthcare professionals to design and deliver high value solutions.
  • Design, build and evaluate solutions that may involve structured or unstructured data for healthcare use cases, delivering capabilities such as predictive models, summarization, recommenders, semantic search, extraction, classification, or other AI/ML applications
  • Perform research and experimentation to select appropriate approaches, algorithms, and evaluation methods, and execute the R&D needed to deliver production-ready model systems.
  • Perform data collection, cleaning, analysis, prompt tuning, parameter fine-tuning, model training, development, and evaluation—using existing or developing new tools or workflows as needed.
  • Apply and help evolve responsible AI evaluation practices, using approaches and frameworks such as LLM-as-judge, RAGAS, and LangSmith, and design and implement custom model performance and quality metrics as needed to ensure model quality, fairness, and safety at scale.
  • Contribute to a collaborative team culture, sharing knowledge and helping develop new capabilities across the organization.

Required Experience

  • Ph.D grad, with 1+ years related industry experience OR Masters grad with 4+ years industry experience--including at least 1 year directly related to healthcare ML/AI
  • Proven industry experience through multiple major product releases in a commercial SaaS environment.
  • Hands-on experience working with healthcare data (e.g. EHR, ADT, clinical notes).
  • Proficiency in Python. Proficiency in Java or other languages helpful.
  • Proficiency with SQL and data engineering for AI/ML applications.
  • Experience working with large datasets using big data frameworks (e.g. Azure Data Lake, Apache Spark or Databricks)
  • Solid understanding of transformer models and LLM-based approaches, including hands-on experience with prompt tuning and PEFT methods (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA) using frameworks such as Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experience building and evaluating models using modern ML packages such as NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, and LightGBM.
  • Experience building and deploying models using public cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud), including familiarity with version control, CI/CD pipelines, and scaling considerations for production ML systems at SaaS scale.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills; comfortable working on a distributed team.
  • Experience with one or more of: reinforcement learning or RLHF, NLP techniques for summarization, extraction, classification, or semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and/or agentic frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex).

At Terrific, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

Media Sales Specialist

Terrific • Remote, Americas • Contract

About Terrific

Terrific Live is a social commerce platform that helps retailers, eCommerce brands, and media groups grow revenue through live, interactive, social-native shopping experiences on their own properties.

Our platform connects audiences and presenters in real time — streaming across Latin America, Europe, and Israel — and turns content into measurable commerce.

We work with leading broadcasters and media companies— helping them unlock new revenue streams through shoppable content and first-party commerce.

The Role

Terrific is already winning in media. Now we need someone who can scale it.

The Media Sales Specialist is responsible for converting broadcasters, publishers, and streaming platforms into paying clients — and expanding those relationships into meaningful, recurring revenue.

This is not a generic sales role. You need to speak fluent “media”: how broadcasters think, how they monetize, where they are stuck, and how to move them.

You’ll translate Terrific’s platform into a clear commercial story for media executives — and close.

What You’ll Do

Revenue Ownership

  • Own the full sales cycle with media companies — from first conversation to signed deal and expansion
  • Close multi-year platform, content, or monetization partnerships with broadcasters and publishers
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified media opportunities across key regions

Market & Customer Understanding

  • Identify how media companies monetize today — and where Terrific creates incremental revenue
  • Position Terrific as a new revenue layer: shoppable content, live commerce, and first-party data
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments (content, digital, commercial, product, exec)

Strategic Selling

  • Translate Terrific’s product into a media monetization story that resonates with executives
  • Diagnose commercial gaps and tie them directly to revenue outcomes
  • Lead high-quality demos and conversations focused on business impact — not features

Partnership Growth

  • Expand initial deals into broader partnerships across properties, formats, and regions
  • Work closely with Customer Success and Product to ensure revenue outcomes are realized
  • Identify upsell opportunities tied to performance, scale, and new use cases

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience selling into broadcasters, publishers, or streaming platforms
  • Strong network within media organizations (commercial, digital, or executive stakeholders)
  • Deep understanding of digital monetization, editorial commerce, and content-driven revenue models
  • Track record of closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals (preferably multi-year partnerships)
  • Ability to translate product capabilities into clear business and revenue outcomes
  • High commercial ownership — you think in revenue, not activity
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where it doesn’t exist
  • Clear, confident communicator — can hold a room with senior media executives

Why Terrific

  • Direct ownership of a fast-growing media revenue channel
  • Work with leading global broadcasters and media companies
  • Sell a product that creates new revenue, not incremental optimization
  • Tight, senior team with real autonomy and speed

Success Looks Like

  • You close your first media deal within ~30–60 days
  • You build a pipeline of high-quality broadcaster opportunities quickly
  • Your deals generate meaningful revenue (target: 3–5x cost within ~6 months)
  • Media partners expand — more properties, more formats, more revenue
Required:
  • Deep experience in at least one of Terrific’s three commercial pillars — eCommerce, Marketing, or Media — and enough fluency across the other two to contribute credibly from day 1.
  • Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. As such, all roles require fluency in written and spoken English.
Be part of the change that’s quietly reshaping how people discover and buy online.
Passionate about social media and e-commerce? Come build what’s next at Terrific.
Please note: We review every application carefully. While we may not be able to respond to everyone, we will reach out to candidates whose experience aligns with what we’re building.

Horace Mann is looking for an AVP Marketing Strategy & Analytics to lead strategy, analytics, and planning across Horace Mann's Local Agent, Call Center, Partnerships, and Internet channels. This leader translates enterprise priorities into clear channel strategies, operating plans, forecasts, investment choices, and performance roadmaps that support profitable growth.

The role brings together distribution performance, lead analytics, market opportunity, and external trends to identify where Horace Mann should recruit, expand, invest, or adjust coverage. The leader will turn complex data into practical recommendations, build decision-support capabilities, and partner across the enterprise to move insight into sustained execution.

This role leads and develops a team of approximately four strategy and analytics professionals, with the capacity to scale as business needs evolve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Marketing and Distribution strategy, analytics, and planning across Local Agent, Call Center, Partnerships, and Internet channels.
  • Translate enterprise priorities into annual and multi-year channel strategies, forecasts, targets, investment choices, and performance roadmaps.
  • Establish key performance indicators and lead operational analytics across the distribution funnel to improve productivity, conversion, growth, retention, and profitability.
  • Own lead analytics from generation through routing, contact, conversion, and retention; identify gaps in lead volume, quality, capacity, and execution and drive corrective action.
  • Partner with Marketing and channel leaders to increase qualified lead flow, improve conversion, and optimize spend based on measurable return.
  • Develop agent growth and market opportunity models that guide recruiting, expansion, investment, territory coverage, and channel capacity decisions.
  • Translate data into practical recommendations that help agents grow their businesses and strengthen sales execution.
  • Build and operationalize dashboards, self-service tools, scorecards, and decision-support capabilities that make performance transparent and actionable.
  • Deliver proactive insights, scenarios, and executive narratives that clearly communicate opportunities, risks, and tradeoffs.
  • Monitor consumer, competitor, economic, technology, and distribution trends and assess their implications for strategy, demand, channel mix, and growth.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with Marketing, Distribution, Finance, Operations, Data and Technology, and other partners from problem definition through implementation and operating adoption.
  • Establish analytics standards, metric definitions, data-quality expectations, and disciplined performance routines across channels.
  • Build, coach, and develop a high-performing strategy and analytics team while planning for future capability and capacity needs.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10 or more years of experience in strategy, analytics, planning, consulting, finance, distribution, or a related leadership discipline; insurance or financial services experience preferred.
  • Significant people-leadership experience with a record of building, coaching, and scaling high-performing strategy and analytics teams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of enterprise or multi-channel strategy, analytics, and planning, with the ability to set direction and drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in operational and sales-funnel analytics, including lead generation, routing, productivity, conversion, growth, retention, and investment effectiveness.
  • Experience supporting field agent, call center, partnership, and digital or direct distribution models and engaging directly with frontline stakeholders.
  • Advanced quantitative and financial acumen, including modeling, forecasting, dashboard development, data visualization, and decision-tool design.
  • Executive-level communication and influence, with the ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for agent, functional, and senior leadership audiences.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous problem definition through implementation and sustained operating adoption.
  • A proactive, externally oriented perspective on customer, competitor, technology, and distribution trends, supported by sound judgment, curiosity, and a bias for action.

Work Environment and Travel

This is a remote position. Periodic travel, including in-person engagement with agents and channel partners, may be required.

Compensation

Base Salary Pay Range:$124,200–$175,800. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other relevant factors.

Annual Incentive Plan: This position is eligible for a target incentive of 20% of eligible earnings, based on company performance.

Capio Group is looking for an experienced Salesforce Technical Lead!

Full-time employee - Remote

Salary: $140,000 - $180,000

About Us:

Capio Group is a California-based Information Technology Consulting firm serving the public sector since 2010. We assist the Government in delivering large, complex systems and solutions. Capio Group is a small, but quickly growing firm that mixes good ideas, with great people, to achieve extraordinary results for our clients. We offer the salary and benefits of the bigger companies, with the added bonus of a flexible workplace and a great work-life balance.

Scope of Work:

Capio Group is looking for an experienced Salesforce Technical Lead to provide services, delivering ongoing maintenance, operational support, and updates for the systems maintained within the three Salesforce client organizations. The Salesforce Technical Lead will ensure the successful implementation of system updates, provide operational support, optimize system performance, and manage the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to maintain high-quality and efficient service delivery. Additionally, the Salesforce Technical Lead will maintain integrations between Salesforce Orgs and external systems, ensuring seamless data flow, and conduct knowledge transfer activities to equip client staff with the necessary skills and expertise for continued operational success. The Salesforce Technical Lead will also be responsible for the procurement and management of Salesforce licenses for the supported orgs, ensuring alignment with system requirements and user needs.
The Salesforce Technical Lead will provide maintenance and operations services tailored to support various objectives, which may include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Responsible for overseeing technical solution design, development leadership, integration strategy, and ensuring alignment with all tasks and deliverables at the Salesforce Org Level.
  • Implement updates and provide ongoing maintenance, along with operational support that includes proactive system monitoring, performance tuning, user assistance, incident response within defined SLAs, regular health checks and documentation updates for existing applications and systems within each Salesforce Org.
  • Implement system updates, including decisive bug fixes and performance optimizations to ensure continuous improvement.
  • Lead and manage all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), from comprehensive requirements gathering to deployment, rigorous testing, and post-deployment support.
  • Maintain the integration processes between these Salesforce Orgs and external systems, guaranteeing seamless data flow and system interoperability.
    Implement adaptive maintenance and apply security fixes to ensure ongoing compliance with the security standards outlined by the client.
  • Ensure that all deliverables consistently meet agreed-upon standards and best practices, thereby optimizing the effectiveness and efficiency of the Salesforce Orgs and their associated
    applications.
  • Conduct thorough knowledge transfer activities for the client staff and its designees, ensuring that all the resources are fully trained and equipped with essential knowledge for operational success.

Mandatory Experience:

  1. Within the last ten (10) years, must have four (4) years of FTE experience in a technical lead or architect role, directly responsible for the design, development, and implementation of integrated IT solutions with
    a. At least 5,000 users (internal and external users combined)

    b. At least 5 million data records

    c. Multi-tier (n-tier) architecture

    d. High availability environments (e.g., clustering, load balancing)

  2. Within the last ten (10) years, must have at least three (3) years of experience leading a team of at least five (5) FTE resources.
  3. Within the last ten (10) years, must have at least three (3) years FTE experience as a Salesforce application developer implementing solutions, including three (3) or more of the following:
    a. Apex
    b. Lightning Web Components
    c. Salesforce Object Query Language (SOQL)
    d. Salesforce Object Search Language (SOSL)
    e. RESTful API development and integration
    f. Salesforce Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud
  4. Must possess a Bachelor’s Degree. Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. A copy of the degree must be provided upon request.

raw.title: Senior Manager, AI Implementations
raw.excerpt: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals.
raw.description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

​General Description:

The Global Commercial and Medical Affairs Technology team at BeOne is seeking a Senior Manager, AI implementation to help operationalize AI capabilities across Commercial and Medical teams. This role sits at the intersection of oncology data, customer and patient journey data, GenAI implementation, and enterprise data platforms.

This role will help define the semantic layer over BeOne's commercial and medical data warehouse, ensuring structured and unstructured data assets are described consistently so AI models, RAG experiences, insight engines, and BI layers can leverage the right data with the right context.

The Senior Manager will coordinate with Commercial, Medical, Data Engineering, Data Science, Compliance, Privacy, and field teams to ensure free-text insight collection, RAG chat interfaces, AI-generated outputs, and customer journey solutions are implemented with appropriate guardrails, traceability, and business relevance.

The ideal candidate brings 3-5 years of recent oncology experience focused on patient journeys and patient-level data, strong familiarity with commercial and medical data ecosystems, and a hands-on builder mindset with the ability to write code, explore emerging platforms, and turn AI concepts into practical capabilities that make cross-functional workstreams more efficient.

Key Responsibilities:

Semantic Layer, Data Context & Insight Engine

  • Lead creation and ongoing governance of a semantic layer on top of the commercial and medical data warehouse, including entities, attributes, definitions, metrics, business rules, relationships, lineage, and data quality expectations.
  • Partner with data engineering, BI, MDM, and business stakeholders to define how patient, HCP, account, field insight, engagement, journey, patient-level, and medical/commercial data assets should be represented for AI use.
  • Translate data definitions and business context into reusable metadata, ontologies, knowledge objects, and retrieval patterns that improve AI model grounding.
  • Support the design of an insight generation engine on top of the data and semantic layers, ensuring outputs are accurate, explainable, timely, and available through the appropriate BI and workflow layers.
  • Define evaluation criteria for data readiness, retrieval quality, insight accuracy, confidence, freshness, source attribution, and business actionability.

Commercial & Medical AI Guardrails

  • Coordinate across Commercial, Medical, field, compliance, privacy, legal, and technology teams to ensure AI guardrails for free-text inputs and field-collected insights are implemented correctly.
  • Establish practical operating procedures for acceptable use, input validation, sensitive data handling, prompt and response controls, human review, and exception management.
  • Monitor adoption and quality of field insight capture workflows, identifying risks related to incomplete context, inconsistent terminology, duplication, bias, hallucination, or inappropriate data use.
  • Ensure AI outputs appropriately reflect approved data sources, business rules, medical/legal/regulatory considerations, and commercial/medical operating boundaries.

RAG, Chat & Knowledge Retrieval Solutions

  • Validate and continuously improve RAG-based chat interfaces across Commercial and Medical teams, including source coverage, retrieval performance, answer quality, citation/traceability, feedback loops, and escalation paths.
  • Work with teams to ensure data and unstructured knowledge assets are collected, curated, permissions-aware, and available for use in chat, summarization, insight, and assistant experiences.
  • Partner with data science and engineering teams to refine embeddings, chunking strategies, metadata filters, prompt templates, evaluation datasets, and LLMOps/monitoring capabilities.
  • Design and run testing processes to confirm RAG outputs are accurate, grounded, consistent, and fit for use in business and medical workflows.

AI-Generated Meeting-Ready Outputs

  • Enhance existing RAG and GenAI models to generate meeting-ready decks, briefs, summaries, talking points, and insight narratives based on unstructured commercial and medical content.
  • Define reusable templates and quality checks for AI-generated presentation materials, including audience, purpose, key message, evidence, caveats, next-best-action, and source attribution.
  • Partner with field, brand, medical, and other commercial teams to connect unstructured content with structured data and BI outputs so meeting materials are timely and decision ready.
  • Drive adoption of automation that reduces manual preparation time while maintaining quality, compliance, and stakeholder trust.

End-to-End Customer Journey & BI Integration

  • Ensure end-to-end customer and patient journey solutions leverage AI capabilities in the intended manner, grounded in BeOne's data landscape and aligned to priority use cases.
  • Map AI use cases to upstream data sources, semantic definitions, model workflows, BI outputs, CRM/field workflows, and user actions.
  • Partner with Commercial and Medical teams to validate that AI-generated insights are reflected accurately and timely in dashboards, reporting layers, and performance-management routines.
  • Bring oncology patient journey expertise to ensure AI-driven insights are clinically and commercially meaningful, with appropriate granularity and limitations clearly understood.

Hands-on Prototyping & Enterprise Implementation

  • Write code and build prototypes, scripts, prompts, evaluation harnesses, APIs, or workflow automations to test and accelerate new AI capabilities.
  • Explore emerging AI platforms, data products, and vendor capabilities; recommend practical fit-for-purpose solutions and help transition successful experiments into scalable delivery.
  • Engage with Corporate Affairs, Procurement, Clinical, and other enterprise teams to identify and support AI solutions that improve efficiency in high-value tasks.
  • Produce documentation, training, demos, and user guidance that help teams adopt AI responsibly and effectively.
  • Support roadmap planning, backlog prioritization, vendor coordination, delivery milestones, and measurement of value/impact.

Governance, Security & Compliance

  • Apply AI governance, model validation/evaluation, data privacy, information security, and regulatory expectations, including HIPAA, GDPR, GxP where applicable.
  • Document model assumptions, source data, prompts, retrieval configurations, known limitations, review controls, and audit trails.
  • Partner with compliance, legal, privacy, and security teams to ensure patient-level data handling, role-based access controls, and promotional/medical content boundaries are respected.
  • Implement monitoring and feedback mechanisms for accuracy, data quality, fairness, hallucination risk, user experience, and operational performance.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in AI, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Biomedical Informatics, Life Sciences, or a related quantitative/technical field; Master's degree preferred.

Qualifications:

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • BS Degree with 7+ years of experience across data products, AI/ML, GenAI implementation, data engineering, BI, or commercial/medical technology in enterprise environments.
  • 3+ years of recent oncology experience focused on patient journeys, patient-level data, customer/HCP engagement, commercial domain, medical domain, and related domain knowledge.
  • Strong understanding of pharmaceutical/biotech commercial and medical data ecosystems, including patient journey data, field insights, CRM/field activity, medical/commercial knowledge assets, omnichannel engagement, and BI/reporting layers.
  • Experience building or governing semantic layers, data catalogs, business glossaries, metadata frameworks, ontologies, knowledge graphs, or metrics layers for AI use.
  • Hands-on experience with GenAI/RAG concepts, including document ingestion, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval strategies, prompt engineering, grounding, evaluation, monitoring, and guardrails.
  • Coding proficiency in Python and SQL; ability to prototype independently and partner effectively with engineering teams.
  • Experience with data warehouse, lakehouse, and cloud platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, or GCP; experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar preferred.
  • Familiarity with LLMOps/MLOps, APIs, workflow automation, data pipelines, and unstructured data processing.
  • Understanding of data privacy, security, compliance, and responsible AI practices in healthcare/life sciences environments.

Business Acumen & Leadership

  • Ability to translate ambiguous business needs into practical AI/data products and technical requirements.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration with Commercial, Medical, field teams, data science, engineering, BI, compliance, privacy, legal, procurement, corporate affairs, clinical, and vendor partners.
  • Executive-ready communication and storytelling skills; ability to explain AI outputs, data limitations, and recommended actions to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive adoption, standardization, and change management across matrixed teams.
  • Builder mindset; comfortable testing new tools, writing code, learning quickly, and moving from proof-of-concept to scalable capability.
  • Strong project/product management skills, including prioritization, requirements definition, delivery coordination, and value measurement.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced degree in AI, data science, biomedical informatics, life sciences, computer science, statistics, engineering, or related field.
  • Experience with oncology product launch, patient-level claims/EHR/EMR data, data tokenization/identity resolution, MDM, or customer 360 capabilities.
  • Experience with automated deck generation, document intelligence, copilot/assistant experiences, or agentic workflows.
  • Experience designing AI evaluation frameworks, prompt libraries, guardrail testing, and monitoring dashboards.
  • Experience in commercial and medical data governance or AI governance committees.

Travel

  • Estimated 10-15%, primarily for key planning sessions, workshops, stakeholder reviews, or major launch initiatives.

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence
  • Communicates with Clarity
Salary Range: $147,800.00 - $192,800.00 annually

BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Actual compensation packages are determined by several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, certifications, relevant education or training, and specific work location. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. Non-Commercial roles are eligible to participate in the annual bonus plan, and Commercial roles are eligible to participate in an incentive compensation plan. All Company employees have the opportunity to own shares of BeOne Medicines Ltd. stock because all employees are eligible for discretionary equity awards and to voluntarily participate in the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The Company has a comprehensive benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking an Oracle EPM Integration Lead with DoW/Federal Oracle ERP implementation experience. The candidate will be part of an Oracle EBS R12 Department of War (DoW) multi-customer solution. This position has direct customer interaction and leads the execution of program goals and objectives. You will learn the customer’s business firsthand and contribute to technology roadmaps that align customer requirements with industry advancements and next generation capabilities. This is a fast-paced work environment that supports business operations for DoW civilian agencies and military services. As an experienced professional in CACI's growing Digital and Enterprise Solutions Line of Business , you will be part of a team environment that provides opportunities to grow and advance, while changing the way the government delivers software applications.


Responsibilities:
•Lead the assessment, documentation, and re-architecture of the legacy ETL integration layer connecting Oracle EBS to Oracle Cloud EPM.

  • Design and implement a modern integration architecture using Oracle Data Management, EPM Automate, and an ETL tool (Databricks or Oracle-native equivalent).
  • Own the end-to-end data flow - metadata governance through EDM, transactional actuals through Data Management, and reporting outputs through OAS/OAC.
  • Resolve the structural BSS/EPM hierarchy mismatch that is causing parent-level OAS reporting failures.
  • Drive EDM implementation as the metadata governance hub.
  • Establish proper dependency management, job monitoring, alerting, and error handling across all agency data loads.
  • Collaborate directly with agency technical leads, the DBA team and Oracle Support on infrastructure-level issues.
  • Produce and present program documentation and briefings to PMO leadership.


    Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent

  • 10+ years in enterprise application integration, including 5+ years in the Oracle ecosystem
    • 5+ years of DoD/Federal financials and sustainment experience
    • Hands on Oracle integration expertise—able to architect and build (not just advise)
    • Experience as a solution architect implementing and supporting complex Oracle EPM solutions
    • Oracle Data Management (EDM/DRM): building integration rules, data loads, and metadata transformations
    • Oracle EBS integration: sourcing GL, Projects, and Purchasing data into downstream planning/analytics systems
    • Oracle EPM Automate: scripting, scheduling, chaining, and orchestration of Cloud EPM jobs
    • Oracle Analytics Server / OBIEE: understanding star schemas, EPM data exposure, and hierarchy alignment
    • Enterprise Data Management (EDM): implementing or governing metadata distribution across EPM applications
    • Integration technologies: JDBC connectivity, REST/SOAP APIs, Unix/Linux scripting, SQL/PLSQL
    • ETL tools: experience with Databricks, ODI, Informatica, or similar
    • Ability to read, maintain, and modernize legacy scripts and PL/SQL packages
    • Strong documentation and presentation skills for program-level solution architecture
    • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain an IT II background investigation.

    Desired:
    • Oracle Cloud EPM Planning: Essbase concepts (BSO, Hybrid BSO, ASO), dimension design, and data mapping
    • Groovy scripting for business rules, automation, and save rules within Oracle EPM
    • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI): tenancy, OAM/OID configuration
    • Experience supporting DoD financial programs (DoW, DLA, or similar defense agencies)
    • Familiarity with PPBE budget cycles, fund accounting, and NGRMS reporting
    • Experience with DoW SDLC processes: gated reviews, Dimensions, change management workflows.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

$82,100-$172,400

Remote Clinical Trial Support Specialist
(Multiple Openings)
Company: Angel City VA — Virtual Clinical Research Support.
Location: Remote (Philippines, Latin America,Georgia, Ukraine, Moldova, Armenia, Azerbajan) .
Employment Type: Full-Time, Part-Time, and Project-Based Opportunities Available
Join Angel City VA — Where Top Clinical Research Talent Gets Discovered.
Angel City VA is a Los Angeles-based, fast-scaling virtual support platform built to power the next generation of clinical research. We partner with independent research sites, sponsors, and CROs to deliver the high-quality remote clinical trial support that keeps studies moving, and demand for our services is growing fast. Our team thrives in a high-energy, fast-paced, and genuinely collaborative environment where sharp, driven professionals do work that matters: advancing the trials that bring new treatments to patients who need it the most. This is your chance to grow alongside a company that is expanding rapidly across the world and investing in the people who make it run.
Here’s the key thing to know: we are actively building a database of high-caliber, pre-qualified candidates from which we draw to staff independent research sites as new opportunities come online. Applying now puts you on our radar early. When the right study or site need arises, we reach out first to the standout talent already in our global pipeline. If you’re ambitious, detail-obsessed, passionate about cutting-edge, scientifically-rigorous, and ethical patient care and ready to be part of something scaling fast, we want to meet you.
About the Role.
We are seeking experienced remote professionals (2-3 years of experience, medical/biopharmaceutical background, and with completed and current GCP and HIPAA training) to support independent clinical research sites, sponsors, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), and healthcare organizations across a wide range of clinical trial operations functions.
This is a multi-disciplinary opportunity designed to identify candidates with expertise in one or more areas of clinical research, patient engagement, regulatory support, study operations, finance, administration, and sponsor relations. Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed below.
Applicants should clearly indicate in their resume and cover letter which functional areas best match their experience and qualifications. Successful candidates will submit 3 references from previous clinical trial positions and will facilitate background checks as needed.
Potential Areas of Responsibility.
Angel City VA supports the full clinical trial lifecycle. The functional areas below reflect the services we provide to our research-site partners. Tell us where your strengths are. We can’t wait to learn about you.
Patient Education & Engagement
• Walk participants through study procedures and visit expectations at each stage of the trial.
• Support the informed-consent process and patient education initiatives.
• Deliver retention touchpoints and follow-up across the full study timeline.
• Answer participant questions and facilitate communication between patients and study teams.
Visit Scheduling & Coordination
• Book participant visits within protocol-defined windows.
• Send appointment reminders and confirmations.
• Conduct proactive follow-up to reduce no-shows and missed visits.
• Track attendance, book transportation, and resolve scheduling conflicts.
• Assist with scheduled patient visits by walking on-site medical staff through protocol-required procedures and documenting visits in electronic source and other systems as needed.
Patient Recruitment & Pre-Screening
• Conduct outreach to prospective study participants.
• Review charts, databases, and referral sources.
• Perform preliminary eligibility screening against study inclusion/exclusion criteria.
• Consult with principal and sub-investigators on suitability of patients for a trial.
• Schedule screening appointments and document recruitment activity.
• Minimize screen failure and maximize patient enrollment and retention.
Study Lead Generation
• Source sponsor and CRO study opportunities.
• Support feasibility-questionnaire responses.
• Track the pipeline for new study awards.
• Research upcoming trials and potential new business.
EHR / EMR Management
• Update and maintain electronic medical records accurately.
• Provide documentation support and chart-completion assistance.
• Support record organization and documentation workflows.
• Maintain compliance with applicable privacy and regulatory requirements.
Data Entry & Source Management
• Enter and maintain data in CTMS, EDC, and other research systems.
• Support query identification and resolution.
• Organize and maintain source documentation.
• Help ensure data is timely, accurate, and audit-ready.
Regulatory Support
• Maintain e-regulatory binders and essential staff documents.
• Manage document version control.
• Track expiration of licenses, certifications, training records, and delegation logs.
• Assist with submissions to sponsors, CROs, IRBs/ECs, and regulatory agencies.
Quality Assurance Support
• Prepare for source-data verification (SDV).
• Log protocol deviations and support corrective/preventive actions.
• Support audit and monitoring-visit readiness.
• Help maintain inspection-ready documentation.
Patient & IP Compliance Support
• Deliver dosing and adherence reminders.
• Follow up on e-diary compliance.
• Maintain investigational product (IP) accountability logs.
• Support participant compliance throughout the treatment period.
Contract & Budget Negotiation Support
• Support clinical trial agreement (CTA) and budget drafting/negotiations.
• Track redlines and contract revisions.
• Reconcile payment terms and financial milestones.
• Maintain organized contract and budget records.
Sponsor / CRO Relations Management
• Serve as a liaison across sponsors, CROs, and study stakeholders.
• Schedule meetings and track action items.
• Monitor deliverables and timelines.
• Support ongoing relationship coordination and stakeholder engagement.
Reimbursement & Stipend Coordination
• Process participant travel reimbursements and stipends.
• Support insurance verification and prior-authorization activities.
• Maintain accurate payment and reimbursement records.
Bookkeeping & Accounting
• Record financial transactions.
• Track accounts payable and accounts receivable.
• Perform reconciliation activities.
• Support financial documentation and record-keeping.
Finance Support
• Prepare and process invoices.
• Track payments and outstanding balances.
• Assist with financial reporting and analysis.
Bilingual Participant Support
• Communicate with participants in multiple languages across a diverse patient population.
• Provide culturally sensitive, patient-facing support.
• Assist with translation and localization of non-medical study communications as needed.
Administrative & Credentialing Support
• Collect and organize onboarding documentation.
• Track staff credentials, certifications, and required training.
• Maintain personnel files and compliance records.
• Support administrative projects and operational initiatives.
IP Remote Temperature Monitoring & Documentation
• Monitor investigational product storage temperatures remotely.
• Document temperature logs and identify excursions.
• Escalate temperature excursions per protocol and sponsor requirements.
• Maintain accurate, inspection-ready temperature records.
