raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Location: US remote-friendly

Reddit has a flexible first workforce. At Reddit we continue to grow our teams with the best talent. We're completely remote friendly and will continue to be after the pandemic.

Advertising is Reddit’s primary revenue driver and we have an ambitious goal to turn it into a massive business. Although several large digital ad platforms already exist, advertisers are being increasingly drawn to Reddit because of our passionate communities. We believe our community-centric platform has created the opportunity for Reddit to build a highly differentiated ads business.

About the Ads Data Science Team:

The Ads Data Science team at Reddit leverages data to maximize advertiser value on Reddit through robust data foundations, metrics, and strategic insights generated through experimentation and cutting-edge DS methods.

We work on a wide range of challenging problems in the areas of ads and platform measurement, campaign and creative management, advertiser growth and retention, monetization, and the intersection of brand and community engagement. We are a highly collaborative team of passionate data scientists and engineers who are constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with machine learning and statistical modeling.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our growing Ads Data Science team. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a key role in developing as well as applying cutting-edge DS models/methods to improve the adoption and performance of our advertising platform through data-driven insights. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and other data scientists to identify opportunities, define metrics, and build solutions that drive significant impact for Reddit.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and apply DS solutions to inform improvements in advertiser experience and Reddit's ad platform
  • Analyze large-scale datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that can be used to improve the effectiveness of our advertising platform
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and translate them into data science solutions
  • Develop ML models & DS methods to improve anomaly detection, prediction, & pattern recognition
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in machine learning and data science
  • Mentor and guide junior data scientists on the team

Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (Masters or Ph.D.) in a quantitative field such as: Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or Operations Research
  • For M.S. holders: 5+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles
  • For Ph.D. holders: 4+ years of industry experience in applied science or data science roles
  • Platform experience and a deep understanding of the ads ecosystem
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, causal inference and experimental design
  • Experience with large-scale data processing and analysis using tools such as Spark, Hadoop, or Hive; knowledge of BigQuery a plus
  • Proficiency in Python or R and experience with machine learning libraries such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Passion for Reddit and the online advertising industry

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with online advertising and ad tech
  • Experience with causal inference and A/B testing
  • Contributions to open-source projects or publications in relevant conferences or journals

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:
$190,800—$267,100 USD

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

raw.description:
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Fullstack Data Scientist with solid expertise in Generative AI (GenAI) to lead projects focused on building and implementing advanced systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs), chatbots, AI agents, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mechanisms. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing GenAI solutions, as well as mentoring teams. Your knowledge and experience will be crucial in making architectural decisions, selecting technologies, and implementing best practices in AI-driven development.

Tasks:

  • Lead discovery and solution design for GenAI use cases, translating business problems into concrete architectures (LLM decision, RAGs, fine-tuning, agents, guardrails).

  • Build end-to-end GenAI applications: data ingestion, retrieval layer, orchestration (e.g. LangChain/LlamaIndex/LangGraph), API/backend, and simple UI where needed.

  • Design and implement RAG pipelines with vector databases, hybrid search, rerankers, query transformation, and evaluation frameworks for relevance and robustness.

  • Perform model selection, prompting strategies, and fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA/SFT) for text, code, and multimodal models, including evaluation and A/B testing.

  • Implement safety, compliance, and governance controls (input/output filters, PII handling, audit logs, human-in-the-loop review where required).

  • Collaborate with data engineers, product owners, and full-stack developers on scalable architectures, SLAs, and integration with existing enterprise systems.

  • Gather technical requirements and estimate planned work.

  • Mentor other data scientists/engineers in GenAI patterns, code quality, and best practices; contribute to internal libraries, templates, and reusable components.

  • Stay current with GenAI landscape (new open and hosted models, agentic frameworks, evaluation techniques) and perform targeted PoCs to validate them.

What We're Looking For:

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Science/AI engineering.

  • At least 4+ years of experience in production-ready Python AI-related code development.

  • At least 2+ years of experience in production-ready LLM-related code development, preferably based on the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concept.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to optimize AI solutions for diverse applications.

  • Strong knowledge and experience in Generative AI, including LLMs, chatbots, AI agents, and RAG mechanisms.

  • Deep understanding of LLM evaluators, validators, and guardrails.

  • Hands-on experience with one or more GenAI frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or similar orchestration stacks.

  • Hands-on experience designing or operating MCP servers/clients for LLM agents

  • Strong Python skills, including production-grade code, packaging, and testing for data/ML services

  • Solid understanding of ML/AI concepts: types of algorithms, machine learning frameworks, model efficiency metrics, model lifecycle, AI architectures.

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as Azure (preferred), GCP, or AWS, including AI-related managed services.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, testing, and containerized deployments.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to various audiences.

What Will Set You Apart:

  • Experience in designing and programming ML algorithms and data processing pipelines using Python.

  • Good understanding of CI/CD and DevOps concepts, with experience working with selected tools (preferably GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Azure DevOps).

  • Experience in productizing ML solutions using technologies like Spark/Databricks or Docker/Kubernetes.

  • Experience with agentic AI development frameworks (e.g., BMAD, multi-agent orchestration, spec-driven AI workflows).

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be contracted by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Opportunity

Lyra’s provider network is composed of in-person and virtual therapists, physicians, and coaches across the US. With our advanced matching technology, supportive provider platform, and opportunities for training and clinical consultation, being part of our network is an incredible chance to do what you love (like patient care) with support for the things you don’t love (like self promotion and scheduling).
We are looking for contract psychiatrists who are passionate about whole-person, whole family mental health care and working within a connected network to provide patients with easily accessible, culturally responsive, high-quality mental health care.
As a contract psychiatrist, you’ll provide evidence-based treatment via live 60-minute video intake appointments and regular follow-up appointments. You'll conduct psychiatric evaluations and provide medication management. Lyra makes it easy to refer patients to evidence-based therapy and coaching services in tandem with your care.
You will provide care to individuals from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, as well as those with varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally-responsive care—an approach that is mindful of the impact of cultural background on each person’s care experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Practice comprehensive mental health medication management via a 60-minute intake appointment and regular follow-up appointments
  • Conduct mental health risk assessments, psychiatric medication evaluations, and longitudinal medication treatment
  • Construct patient-centered treatment plans, document treatment recommendations, message patients, and prescribe and manage psychiatric medications
  • Experience and commitment to providing, evidence-based medication treatment that follows clinical best practice guidelines (e.g., measurement based care, patient-centered care

Requirements:

  • Board certified MD or DO in psychiatry
  • Unrestricted state license in Maryland, other states a plus
  • Strong preference for clinicians with an active DEA license
  • Must have office space with ability to see clients
  • Ability to provide care to patients with a full range of diagnoses, clinical complexity, and severity levels, with a preference for providers who offer in-person options
  • Full-time resident of the United States

Here are some of the advantages of joining the Lyra provider network:

  • Set your own schedule without a minimum hours requirement
  • Focus less on the administrative burden of billing with Lyra’s paperless billing and quick payment turnaround
  • Access to a custom-built calendar for new patients to connect seamlessly
  • Access to experienced clinical consultations to get rapid support with your patients as well as access a range of specialty group consultation meetings
  • Have peace of mind with Lyra’s 24/7 Care Navigation team for client crisis support

raw.description:
About us:
Creative Chaos is an AI orchestration company. We help businesses re-engineer how work actually gets done by placing AI orchestrators inside their teams to redesign workflows, deploy agents, and rewire operations end-to-end.

Job Summary:
The Principal AI Process Orchestrator is a key role. This is the person who decides what work humans do and what work AI does, and then designs and ships the systems that make both happen.

You will front every engagement. You will earn trust with the client’s executive team in week one. You will lead the work from workflow audit to shipped automation. You will carry 3-4 concurrent clients and lead Associate Orchestrators through implementation.

This is a senior individual contributor role. We are not hiring a manager. We are hiring the sharpest business analyst you know, the one who also spends their weekends building AI agents and has strong opinions about which tool to use for which job.

Job Description:

  • Lead client engagements end-to-end: You are the face of the engagement. You sit across from the client’s COO or CEO in week one, not week six. You own the weekly update, the monthly business review, and the strategic direction of the work.
  • Map the business: In the first 30 days of any engagement, you learn how work flows through the client’s organization. You produce an opportunity map that identifies the 5-10 workflows where AI can materially change the economics of the business.
  • Design the future state: For the 2-3 workflows selected for transformation, you design the rewired version. What humans do. What agents do. Where the handoffs live. What the evals look like. How success is measured.
  • Ship the implementation: You scope the work, direct the Associate Orchestrators on the engagement, review their output, and ship the first automation to production within 60 days of engagement start.
  • Grow the engagement: You identify when a client needs a Build pod, a Rescue, or ongoing Support, and pull the right Creative Chaos resource in. Transformation is the front door. You open the rest of the house.
  • Own the outcome: You report on measurable client impact: hours saved, error rates reduced, throughput gained. Numbers, not narratives.

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience as a business analyst, solutions engineer, or technical consultant in software delivery, product, or enterprise SaaS. You have sat between business stakeholders and technical teams. You have interviewed users, mapped workflows, written specs, and owned the result. You are on an individual contributor track and not looking to manage people.
  • Deeply AI-native: Not “uses ChatGPT daily.” You have built and deployed real agents. You use Claude Code as a daily tool, not a curiosity. You have opinions about Cursor vs. Windsurf, LangChain vs. LlamaIndex, and which MCP to use when, because you have actually tried all of them. You can name the right tool for the right job and defend the choice.
  • Portfolio over resume: You can show us a GitHub, side projects, deployed agents, and public writing on what you have built. We do not hire anyone who cannot show us what they have built with their own hands. A resume is not enough. A repo is.
  • Business-native English and executive poise: You have worked with or inside US or Western companies. You can run a stakeholder workshop with twelve people in the room without losing control of it. When you walk into a US CEO’s office, you command the meeting from minute one.
  • Curious and hungry: You learn a new tool every week on your own time. When you are given a well-understood problem, you dig into something adjacent that nobody asked you to look at. You built something last weekend because you wanted to see if you could.

How we hire

This is a portfolio hire, not a resume hire.

Portfolio review: We read everything before we talk to you. If the work is not there, there is no interview.

Technical conversation: 45 minutes. We walk through your agent, your design decisions, and the tools you reached for.

Live exercise: 48 hours. We share a real workflow from one of our portfolio companies. You design how you would rewire it, map the humans-vs-agents split, and sketch the 30/60/90 implementation plan.

Final conversation with the Leader: 60 minutes. Direct, a go or no-go decision within 48 hours.

What Creative Chaos offers

- Direct access to the managing partner and a small senior team

- A clean mandate: you own the engagement, we clear the path

- Best-in-class tooling: Claude, Claude Code, MCPs, and every agent framework worth trying

- The chance to define a new category of work before the market has a name for it

- Compensation open and based on capability and experience

The Business Unit FP&A Specialist will lead financial oversight, planning and analysis for one or more of RecargaPay’s Business Units (e.g. Payments, Credit, Cards, Acquiring, or others as the business evolves). The role requires a strategic financial expert with a robust understanding of the Brazilian financial market combined with a hands-on approach. We’re looking for a flexible, adaptable profile — someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment where business lines can shift, merge, or scale quickly. The ideal candidate sees change as opportunity and brings the versatility to add value across different products and verticals. The person in this position will be responsible for BU financial performance (revenues and costs — direct and indirect), reporting accuracy, developing financial models, and ensuring alignment between financial strategies and operational goals.

Requirements

  • Financial Planning and Analysis: Develop and manage detailed financial models, forecasts, budgets and long-term plans for the assigned Business Unit(s). Collaborate with the Consolidation team and BU leaders to ensure accurate financial projections. Lead initiatives under your role to optimize processes while maintaining quality and compliance.
  • Performance Monitoring: Establish KPIs and monitor BU financial performance, analyzing variances and advising on corrective actions. Provide actionable insights for decision-making at both strategic and operational levels.
    Financial Reporting: Lead the preparation of accurate and timely BU financial reports (matched with Accounting reports), consolidating data to provide a clear view of business performance. Work closely with the Financial Consolidation team and Senior Finance team on assisting them with BU-level details in reporting to investors and stakeholders.
  • Risk Management: Identify and mitigate financial risks within the assigned Business Unit(s), with a keen understanding of the Brazilian financial market’s unique risks and regulatory environment.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a financial advisor to Business Unit leaders, helping them drive decisions that align financial outcomes with business objectives. Partner with Operations, Product, and Technology teams for seamless financial integration.
  • Data & AI: Be able to work with several different data sources and Data teams in order to have data summarized as necessary for your reports and controls. Actively leverage AI tools and automation to enhance analysis, reporting, and decision-making — we expect this role to be at the forefront of AI adoption in the Finance team.
  • Requirements
    Educational background: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or related field preferred. Professional certifications (CPA, CFA) or Master’s degree would be a plus.
  • Experience: Proven experience in FP&A, business finance, or financial planning roles within the Brazilian financial market is essential. Ideal candidates will have backgrounds in digital banking, payment companies, or fintechs. Experience with credit products (personal loans, credit cards, or credit lines) is a strong differentiator.
  • Hands-on approach to day-to-day activities.
  • Strong financial modeling and analytical skills across different types of business units and products.
  • Advanced Excel (Google Sheets). • Advanced knowledge to work with data sources in different tools.
  • AI fluency: Demonstrated experience using AI tools (LLMs, copilots, automation) in a professional context. We expect candidates to embrace AI and apply it across their workflow — from modeling and analysis to reporting and communication.
  • Flexibility and adaptability: Ability to pivot across business lines, products, and priorities as the company evolves. We value profiles that are comfortable operating in a dynamic environment where the scope of work may change.
  • Good knowledge of Brazilian Accounting Standards and regulatory requirements. US GAAP knowledge would be a plus. Languages

We are a trilingual team with executive leadership operating across English, Spanish, and Portuguese on a daily basis. We value professionals who can communicate effectively in all three languages at a working/executive level.

  • Portuguese: Fluency required (working language in Brazil).
  • English: Fluency required (investor relations, reporting, executive communication).
  • Spanish: Strongly preferred (daily working language with leadership and cross-functional teams). Candidates with all three languages at executive level will be prioritized.

Soft Skills

  • Analytical and detail-oriented: Strong ability to analyze complex financial data and provide insightful recommendations. Strategic mindset: Able to see the big picture while managing the details, with a strong focus on business growth
  • Ownership, autonomy, and accountability.
  • Influence without authority.
  • Collaboration across teams and geographies.
  • Adaptability: Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-changing business environment.
  • Curiosity and continuous learning: Proactive in adopting new tools, methods, and technologies — especially AI.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the Use of Your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Soluna is on a mission to solve one of renewable energy's biggest challenges: wasted power. Our data centers convert excess solar, hydro, and wind energy into productive computational work, such as Bitcoin mining, artificial intelligence, and machine learning. By co-locating with renewable power sources, we bring demand directly to the source, helping power plants increase revenue while contributing more megawatts to the grid.

We are looking for a Director, Strategy & Development to join our world-class team.

This is a high-visibility, mission-critical role that sits squarely at the intersection of Corporate Development, Project Development, and Strategic Finance. You will work closely with senior leadership to own the full execution cycle: evaluating and structuring strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new build opportunities. You must bring both analytical rigor (robust modeling, diligence, and valuation) and creative dealmaking (structuring and negotiation) to the table, directly influencing the geographic footprint and technological diversification of Soluna's platform.

Soluna is entering an unprecedented phase of accelerated growth, strategically expanding our pioneering platform across North America through aggressive joint ventures, high-impact M&A, and greenfield development. This role puts you at the epicenter of that expansion, with the independence to drive complex initiatives from analysis through execution.

What You'll Do

Partnerships & Commercial Structuring

  • Develop and evaluate commercial structures for customer partnerships and joint ventures, taking ownership of deal terms and economic outcomes.
  • Lead negotiations with counterparties and coordinate with legal and technical teams through closing.
  • Build and maintain financial models to assess transaction economics and risk across a range of deal structures.

M&A & Asset Transactions

  • Drive financial and strategic analysis for M&A, asset acquisitions, and divestitures.
  • Build DCF, precedent, and comparable transaction models independently, with limited oversight.
  • Coordinate diligence, prepare investment memos, and lead integration planning.

Project Development

  • Originate and evaluate new site opportunities for modular data centers across North America.
  • Assess interconnection, permitting, and market conditions to inform go/no-go decisions.
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and power marketing teams to optimize project design and returns.

What You Bring
Required

  • 6–9 years of experience in investment banking, corporate development, project finance, or strategy within energy, infrastructure, or data centers.
  • Strong command of financial modeling, valuation, and transaction structuring.
  • Proven ability to independently manage complex deal processes from analysis through execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of engaging directly with senior leadership and external partners.
  • Curiosity about both renewable energy and AI infrastructure, and a desire to work where those two worlds meet.

Preferred

  • MBA, CFA, or similar credential.
  • Experience in greenfield project development, including permitting and interconnection.

Why Join Soluna?

We are a diverse, driven team of entrepreneurs, energy experts, private equity leaders, storytellers and engineers. We are passionate about making the world greener and we have conviction about how we will bring change on a global scale.

We are equally as zealous about championing our teams, relentless about developing our people, and believe strongly that Soluna's goals and commitment to our mission are strengthened by our employee's voices.

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager
raw.excerpt: Who We AreAt Murmuration, we believe that America's promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Murmuration, we believe that America's promise is shaped and reshaped by the best ideas and ideals of its communities, and the dreams of the people who believe in a better life for themselves, their families, and each other.

We help organizations build power in their communities in four key ways: We organize a network of values-aligned partners; we provide deep, data-driven insights into people, places, and perspectives; we develop tools that make organizing and engagement easy and more effective; and we offer services that strengthen our partners' capacity to lead change in their communities.

We envision an America where every community has what it needs to help people lead healthy, free, and dignified lives. We work to redesign the systems and structures we all depend on — how we learn, live, govern, and solve problems — so that they are just, equitable, resilient, and rooted in shared responsibility. By strengthening the ties that hold communities together, we aim for civic life defined by collective action and care, with effective leadership that truly represents everyone.

We are a collaborative, curious, and creative team of organizers, scientists, teachers, technologists, campaign veterans, and more who share the unwavering belief that we can use our gifts in service of transforming America — together.

We've built our team guided by the belief that the whole is greater than the sum of its parts. And so we support each other relentlessly — rallying together to face challenges the same way we celebrate each other's wins.

About the Position

Do you see yourself as a mission-driven Senior Engineering Manager who believes that great products emerge from strong teams? Do you have a curiosity and passion for bringing related areas together and coaching people of different backgrounds and technical expertise into a cohesive, collaborative team? Do you thrive in inclusive, thoughtful environments where engineers hold themselves to high standards of technical excellence, ownership, and impact at scale?

The Murmuration Engineering Team is seeking an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to grow and develop the multidisciplinary team (DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps) that builds and maintains the shared systems that all of our teams depend on. Your guidance and influence on this team will raise the bar across the engineering organization.

Murmuration builds technology that helps our partner organizations strengthen civic engagement and organize more effectively in their communities. Our products weave together engagement, outreach, demographic, and voter data into intuitive applications that help partners better understand and act within the communities they serve. Our team is intentionally multidisciplinary and partner-focused. We succeed together by aligning planning, execution, and learning across engineering, product, design, research, data, and partner success. We build complex, data-driven systems that need to work reliably during critical moments, scale as our partners grow, and remain understandable and maintainable as communities and their needs evolve.

As a Senior Engineering Manager, you'll join the Platform Team to support both production and prototype applications and the services they're built upon. You'll coach and grow a small, cross-discipline team that owns the outcomes for the org's build/deploy/run systems, with accountability for other teams' ability to ship fast, safely, and reliably. The team’s disciplines span DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps domains.

Your leadership actively shapes the team's operating model, evolving it to serve the Engineering organization's current and future needs. Your strategic thinking turns vision into sequenced deliverables and adapts as priorities shift without losing sight of where the team is headed. Your commitment to high-quality documentation improves knowledge sharing, onboarding, and long-term product maintainability across Murmuration.

Your ability to work across engineering teams, understanding their goals and shaping the org's engineering roadmap around them, is key to making the Platform Team successful.

This role suits a deeply experienced Senior Engineering Manager who can evaluate where we are today, absorb shifts in direction, and keep us on track. Your commitment to building inclusive, high-trust, high-performing teams is visible across the technology organization. And you believe, as we do, that how we build is just as important as what we build.

Job Level: M4

Drive & Model

  • Shape technical strategy for the team: Build an engineering roadmap that keeps the team focused on big-picture objectives and that reflects tradeoffs among competing priorities, dependencies, and complexities across DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps. Propose clear recommendations and plans, and present well-reasoned documentation of tradeoffs and alternatives.
  • Manage technical debt and process health: Maintain a steady cadence of debt paydown, prioritizing which debt to tackle and communicating the reasoning behind those choices. Own the schedule of dependency and application updates so end-of-life deadlines are handled proactively rather than as last-minute fire drills.
  • Deliver production-ready platforms: Own the platforms and tooling that give other teams a stable, observable foundation of reliability, performance, and operational excellence so they can focus on building and testing their own applications on top of it.
  • Strengthen application security: Introspect codebases to identify vulnerabilities early, and own data privacy and access control as first-class concerns; deliver solutions that support secure coding practices across the org without owning how other teams write their code.
  • Enable FinOps visibility: Build and own the single panes of glass that give engineering leadership and the C-suite a clear, trusted view of cloud and infrastructure costs, supporting both short-term budget decisions and long-term cost strategy.
  • Architect for the long term: Design and build systems and architectures that will serve Murmuration for years with scale, reliability, security, and maintainability as first-class concerns.

Elevate the Team

  • Coach and empower emerging leaders: Coach leaders to lead at every level: Within their own teams, as good, collaborative, and experienced peers, and through mentoring ICs around them.
  • Resolve ambiguity: Actively shape and bring structure and clarity (not perfection) to specs.
  • Listen and elevate: Stay closely attuned to how other teams approach test strategy, code quality, and system design, and use that insight to ensure that what our team builds and delivers elevates their developer journey.
  • Be like Ted Lasso: Believe, coach the whole team, build trust, and demonstrate kindness, empathy, optimism, curiosity, and vulnerability.

Lead Beyond Platform

  • Lead beyond the Platform team: Own objectives that span multiple teams and align with division and organizational goals.
  • Be the voice: Lead with ownership and accountability on behalf of DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps; seek opportunities to add clarity, make high-quality recommendations, and be a decision-maker in discussions with product and leadership.
  • Identify risk: Identify, document, and follow-up in a timely manner on vulnerabilities and operational risk across the full platform, including applications built by other teams.
  • Lead incident response: Involve the right people across DevOps, App Security, SRE and FinOps, lead the response, conduct root cause analysis, and follow through until learnings are shared, incorporated, and remediation is complete.

Build with Vision

  • Build one internal engineering system, not four Platform teams: Treat DevOps, App Security, SRE, and FinOps as interdependent subsystems where the outcome depends on how well they integrate, not how well each performs alone.
  • Present a cohesive voice and narrative externally: Lead with expertise and a cohesive single voice about the Platform Team’s mission and deliverables to our peer teams.
  • Be curious about people, not just systems: Identify opportunities to foster curiosity and ease communication between people who come from different backgrounds, experiences, and technical lenses.
  • Use AI to amplify: Surface risks and gaps that manual review would miss, and measure team progress together towards shared goals.

Requirements

Technical Depth and Judgement

  • Deep, hands-on expertise across DevOps and SRE: Your direct prior experience informs your approach to prioritizing competing work, communicating tradeoffs clearly, and explaining how a decision in DevOps, SRE, AppSec, or FinOps supports the organization as a whole.
  • Sound judgment under imperfect information: Make tradeoff calls to generate clarity in ambiguous situations.
  • Communicates effectively: Explain to non-technical leadership why an architecture decision is sound without needing the original author in the room.
  • Champions team decisions: Advocate for the team's technical decisions to peers, product, and leadership.

Scope, Initiative, and Execution

  • Lead execution at scale: Lead technical execution for initiatives spanning multiple teams or systems, balancing quality, performance, and cost while keeping stakeholders aligned on tradeoffs and risks.
  • Turn strategy into shipped deliverables: Translate objectives aligned with division and organizational goals into clear epics, stories, and tickets, anticipating technical challenges and proposing solutions before they become blockers.
  • Plan through ambiguity: Estimate large, cross-team projects with unknowns, building mitigation plans for what’s unresolved, and breaking work into milestones and iterations to reduce risk and deliver incremental value.
  • Drive to completion: Involve decision makers, delegate clearly, communicate consistently, and follow through as an owner, in a timely manner, until an outcome is delivered.
  • Multiply team effectiveness: Use technical leadership, tooling, infrastructure, and process improvements to multiply the impact of both the Platform Team and the Engineering organization.

Organizational Impact

  • Influence beyond the team: Shape outcomes beyond your own team through role modeling, documentation, and advocacy.
  • Mentor future leaders: Develop future technical leaders, building their judgment, ownership, and skills through 1:1 guidance and small-group knowledge sharing.
  • Raise the engineering bar: Drive the standards and best practices that raise the bar across the organization, creating processes that instill ownership behavior in others.
  • Lead by example: Proactively share context and learnings with an eye to creating the kind of high-trust, high-performing team culture that makes everyone better.

What You Bring to the Table

Foundations

  • 10+ years of professional software manager engineering experience with demonstrated fluency across infrastructure, systems, and application layers, and a track record of delivering in production across a variety of languages, tools, and technology stacks.
  • A quality-driven mindset with experience writing, maintaining, and driving infrastructure and deployment safety checks at the team or product level.
  • A track record of effective collaboration with product, data science, and R&D teams, bridging technical and domain-specific perspectives across disciplines.

DevOps

  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and release engineering practices.
  • Production experience with AWS, including compute, storage, and networking services.
  • Proficiency with Docker, Make, or similar build tools, as well as environment scripting.

raw.description:
At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar. To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform. We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Our team is a blend of solar-industry veterans and newbies, thought-leaders, dreamers, software, electrical and mechanical engineers, coders, product managers, project managers, and sales and marketing professionals. We are based in Northern California, with several other offices in the United States and around the world.

We are seeking a Design Engineer to create PV power plant designs for projects from early stages of the project life cycle to detailed engineering for construction. Design Engineers are capable of creating highly detailed array layouts based on project site conditions, customer preferences, and their own knowledge of current technologies during the conceptual stages to optimize the value of the project. During the detailed engineering phase of the project, the Design Engineer will coordinate with internal and external resources as needed to generate the engineering package, obtain necessary construction permits, and assist in construction administration during the installation of the system.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated experience in utility power plant scale solar PV systems design, a knack for problem solving, is comfortable in dynamic situations, and detail-oriented. Experience in AutoCAD and Civil 3D is a must.

Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Follow standards and goals for the engineering department
  • Assist in documenting and developing industry best practices, standards and guidelines
  • Attend project meetings, develop reports and status of design deliverables
  • Prepares detailed mechanical, electrical, civil, and structural designs for solar arrays
  • Coordinates with Project Managers, and other project participants to define project design basis and project goals
  • Work with internal and external design and engineering partners:
  • Architecting and developing detailed design documentation including System Architecture Diagrams, Device Points List, IP lists, Logic Diagrams, etc.
  • Uses understanding of system performance, construction logistics, material and labor costs to optimize designs
  • Responsible for creating and maintaining design packages
  • Adopts necessary document control measures to manage internal and external design documentation
  • Creates Bills of Materials for projects
  • Holds design review meetings with internal and external parties as needed to maintain proper QC/QA on their projects
  • Assists in development of departmental processes and best practices for the team

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or related field
  • Ability to effectively communicate with team members and business partners
  • Minimum of 3 years project engineering experience in the design/build, EPC or utility SCADA solar (PV) and Battery (BESS) generation field producing technical CAD documents
  • Experience with communications architectural design
  • Proficient AutoCAD skills, SolidWorks is a plus
  • Working knowledge of electrical and SCADA design, materials and methods of installation
  • Experience in the solar PV industry or other power generation sectors, and experience creating utility scale permitting and construction documents
  • Working knowledge of communications and network design principles
  • Experience working on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Participated in or led continued improvement/lessons learned programs

Benefits

Compensation And Benefits

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Range: $85,000 - $105,000 (DOE). Within each posted range, individual pay is determined (and may be greater or higher), dependent on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Terabase offers competitive compensation along with a comprehensive benefits package, including:

• Generous time off and holiday policy

• Remote flexibility

• Flexible time off

• Comprehensive benefits package

• Career progression

• 401k match

• Stock options

• Home office set up allowance

• And much more!

Terabase is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job-related qualifications and abilities. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply.

We do not discriminate for any reason including race, color, sex, gender, age, religion or religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military/ veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

We offer a welcoming and inclusive environment in service to one another, our products, the diverse consumers we represent, and the communities we call home.

Brilliant Agency, one of the most respected and rapidly growing agencies focused on family-oriented brands, seeks a REMOTE Design & Presentations Intern, 15 hours a week to help support the agency’s growing, award-winning team beginning June 1 and ending December 18.

Who We Are:

So what’s Brilliant all about? We are a unique Marketing agency with nearly 25 team members across the US. We give our team the resources they need to get their work done without having to sit in a cubicle or stuffy office. From costume contests to virtual happy hours and Slack GIFs, we prioritize connecting with each other and creating a sense of community.

What We Do:

We specialize in PR, Influencer, and Social Media services for consumer lifestyle brands across a variety of categories including baby/maternity, toys/games, food/beverage, and CPG.

Our Dream Team Member:

  • Resourceful, committed, and deliberate
  • Strong eye for design, layout, and visual storytelling
  • Able to translate a specific vision into clean, compelling slides for more visual storytelling
  • Comfortable working in Canva (presentations + graphics)
  • Understands how to simplify information visually (not just make things “look good”)
  • Detail-oriented with typography, spacing, and consistency
  • Open to feedback and quick iterations
  • Interested in how design supports strategy, storytelling, and client work
  • Excited about building a strong career foundation to build from post graduation.
  • Video and post-production editing capabilities not required but a PLUS!

Job Description:

We have two internship sessions – Spring/Summer (January - May/August) and Fall/Winter (June or August - December) – and many interns end up staying for multiple sessions. Active interns get first pick for the following semester internship spots!

This isn’t an internship to organize files or provide admin support. Your work will provide a meaningful contribution to Brilliant as an agency and to its clients. You will receive true agency experience with opportunities to collaborate with different departments and exposure to agency life should that be a long-term career path you want to explore. With that, it is critical that interns can meet deadlines, respond to messages in a timely manner, and be proactive in communicating with their team.

Potential Responsibilities Include:

Presentation & Slide Design:

  • Translate team ideas, outlines, and data into clean, visually compelling slides
  • Build and update presentations using Brilliant templates in Canva
  • Help improve slide structure, flow, and clarity for internal and client decks
  • Turn messy content into polished, easy-to-understand visuals

Graphic Design Support:

  • Create simple graphics for internal and client needs (social mockups, one-pagers, etc.)

Creative Collaboration:

  • Work with account teams to bring ideas to life visually
  • Share ideas for improving templates and design systems

Internship Structure:

  • Summer/Fall Session (2026): starting June 1 (or sooner) and ending December 18

While these are our preferred timelines, we are still flexible with potential start and end dates based on candidate availability.

Requirements for a successful candidate include:

  • You must be a rising sophomore, junior or senior.
  • Experience using Canva (required)
  • Intermediate understanding of presentation design and layout
  • Ability to work from a template and also improve upon it
  • Portfolio or sample work (presentations or graphics)
  • Ability to commit to at least 15 hours a week during office hours, 8–5 in your time zone
  • Professional demeanor and a drive to succeed
  • Eagerness to learn and willingness to ask questions
  • Resourceful attitude and keen attention to detail

***Prior to applying for this position, please contact your College or University Career Center and verify that you are eligible to receive College Credits for an Internship although accepting credit hours is not necessary to accept an offer. If selected, Brilliant will reimburse you $250 each month for using your personal cell phone, computer, and home internet.***

raw.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The QA Specialist plays an integral role in the review process as they are responsible for communicating with the customer, reviewer, and management to ensure a completed report is delivered by the customer requested due date.

The QA Specialist is responsible for the timely completion and overall completeness of a reviewer report. Completeness is determined by customer requirements, company best practices, and clinical accuracy. In addition, the QA Specialist participates in improving DS processes and works with the Manager to ensure high efficiencies are achieved.

Dane Street’s success relies on individual and team contributions every day. We care for our customers, each other and Dane Street. It is the responsibility for all of us to maintain a positive working environment that promotes client satisfaction and results.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Client Interaction

  • Provides regular report status updates to the client.
  • Evaluates the Quality of physician’s report and determines if the report will meet all client and jurisdictional standards; the QA Specialist is also responsible for ensuring that the clinical rationale supports the physician’s determinations.
  • Clarifies ambiguous report questions with clients.
  • Distribute final report back to client according to client specific requirements.
  • Receives, coordinates & executes all aspects of clarification & addendum requests from the client.
  • Participates in phone calls OR meetings with client(s) when a report is in question.
  • Follow up with the client for any missing information that is pertinent to the referral.

Physician Interaction

  • Works directly with physicians to ensure that all client questions are answered and supported by clinical rationale.
  • Conduct regular follow up with the physician or their office staff to ensure an on-time delivery of the report.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written feedback to the doctor regarding report quality.
  • Compose and provide verbal or written requests to the physician or their office staff for clarifications.
  • Receive written or verbal confirmation from the physician that a report has the doctor’s approval and ensures the doctor provides his/her signature for the final report.

Report Analysis

  • Review each physician report for data accuracy including spelling, grammar & punctuation.
  • Responsible for ensuring that all state requirements for reporting are met.
  • Responsible for report format and adhering to each client’s specific requirements.
  • Must ensure that all client special handling instructions with regard to report completion and delivery are met.

Additional Duties

  • May provide oversight to the work of the team members.
  • Continuously improves processes that help to facilitate better turnaround time, peer to peer success rates and lessens returned reports by clients for clarification purposes, ultimately resulting in higher client satisfaction.
  • Responsible for the final approval on cases for release to the client.
  • Will act as a liaison and coordinate quality issue reports along with all new reviewer reports with the VP of Clinical Operations.

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

Requirements

EDUCATION/CREDENTIALS:

An Associate’s Degree or Bachelor’s Degree is preferred.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Business experience in a healthcare and/or insurance setting is preferred.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

Present exceptional communication skills with a clear understanding of company business lines. The ability to apply critical thinking, manage time efficiently and meet specific deadlines. Computer literacy and typing skills are essential.

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Any lifting, bending, traveling, etc. required to do the job duties listed above. Long periods of sitting and computer work.

WORK FROM HOME TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Supply and support their own internet services.

Maintaining an uninterrupted internet connection is a requirement of all work from home position.

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

Full Stack Engineer

Next.js, React, Python, AI & Marketing Technology | Remote | EST Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours – EST

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients—a fast-growing marketing agency serving 150+ home service businesses—is hiring a Full Stack Engineer to build and scale the technology powering its marketing, lead generation, tracking, and revenue operations.

This is a hands-on builder role, not a strategy-only engineering position.

You’ll work across:

  • Full-stack application development
  • Marketing data and attribution
  • Meta Pixel & Conversion API (CAPI)
  • AI-powered marketing workflows
  • CRM integrations and automation
  • Internal dashboards and operational tools

You’ll work directly with leadership, media buyers, and operators to turn real business problems into production-ready systems that improve campaign performance, lead conversion, and operational efficiency.

If you’re a strong full-stack engineer who understands both software engineering and performance marketing technology, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Full-Stack & Internal Tool Development — Primary Focus

Build, deploy, and maintain internal applications using:

  • Next.js
  • React
  • Python

You’ll:

  • Develop marketing dashboards and reporting systems
  • Build internal operational tools used by media buyers and teams
  • Replace repetitive manual workflows with scalable software
  • Develop reliable backend services and integrations
  • Take systems from concept through production deployment
  • Continuously improve tools based on real user and campaign needs

Marketing Data, Tracking & Attribution — Core Focus

Own and improve the technical infrastructure connecting advertising performance to actual business outcomes.

You’ll:

  • Implement and optimize Meta Pixel
  • Work hands-on with Meta Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Configure accurate event tracking
  • Handle event deduplication
  • Improve attribution accuracy
  • Troubleshoot tracking discrepancies
  • Build pipelines connecting:

Ad Platforms → Backend Systems → CRM → Reporting Dashboards

Develop reporting systems that give teams visibility into metrics such as:

  • ROAS
  • CPL
  • CAC
  • Conversion rates
  • Lead quality
  • Campaign performance

AI Integration & Marketing Automation

Build AI directly into live marketing and operational workflows.

Use APIs such as OpenAI and similar AI platforms to develop systems for:

  • Ad copy generation
  • Creative ideation
  • Lead scoring
  • Lead qualification
  • Campaign analysis
  • Performance insights
  • Automated reporting
  • Operational workflow automation

This role requires someone who actively uses modern AI tools—not someone with only theoretical exposure.

CRM & Lead Lifecycle Automation — Critical

Integrate and automate CRM platforms such as:

  • GoHighLevel
  • Close CRM
  • HubSpot
  • Similar CRM systems

Build workflows connecting the entire lead lifecycle:

Lead Capture → CRM → Routing → Follow-Up → Pipeline → Conversion → Attribution

You’ll also:

  • Automate lead routing and assignment
  • Build pipeline management workflows
  • Configure webhooks and API integrations
  • Sync CRM conversion outcomes back to advertising platforms
  • Support offline conversion and CAPI event tracking
  • Maintain data consistency across systems
  • Troubleshoot broken integrations and automation workflows

APIs, Webhooks & Systems Integration

Build reliable connections between marketing and operational platforms.

You’ll work extensively with:

  • REST APIs
  • Webhooks
  • Third-party integrations
  • Automation platforms
  • CRM APIs
  • Advertising APIs
  • AI APIs
  • Backend data flows

Ensure systems remain accurate, scalable, and reliable as campaign volume grows.

Rapid Execution & Iteration

This is a fast-moving environment where engineering directly impacts revenue.

You’ll:

  • Ship production-ready solutions quickly
  • Test systems using real campaign data
  • Iterate based on performance and user feedback
  • Work closely with media buyers to identify bottlenecks
  • Troubleshoot operational and technical issues
  • Prioritize solutions that create measurable business impact
  • Balance speed with reliability and maintainability

Required Experience & Skills

Non-Negotiables

  • 4–6+ years of hands-on software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack development experience with:
    • React
    • Next.js
    • Python
  • Proven experience building and deploying production-level applications or internal tools
  • Strong experience with:
    • APIs
    • Webhooks
    • Third-party integrations
    • Automation systems
  • Active use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work

Marketing / Ad Tech Experience

Hands-on experience in a marketing, advertising, performance marketing, or ad tech environment is required.

You should have experience with:

  • Meta Pixel and/or Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Event tracking
  • Event deduplication
  • Attribution
  • Marketing analytics
  • Campaign reporting
  • Advertising data pipelines

Experience building dashboards or reporting systems for paid marketing campaigns—particularly Meta Ads—is strongly preferred.

CRM & Automation Experience

Hands-on experience integrating or automating platforms such as:

  • GoHighLevel
  • Close CRM
  • HubSpot
  • Similar CRM systems

You should understand:

  • Lead capture
  • Lead routing
  • Pipeline management
  • Follow-up automation
  • Conversion tracking
  • Offline events
  • CRM-to-ad-platform attribution

Nice to Have

  • Experience working inside a performance marketing agency
  • Experience supporting high-volume lead generation campaigns
  • Familiarity with paid media metrics such as:
    • ROAS
    • CPL
    • CAC
    • Conversion rate
  • Experience with:
    • Zapier
    • Make
    • Similar automation platforms
  • Understanding of marketing data pipelines
  • Familiarity with attribution challenges caused by:
    • iOS privacy changes
    • Browser restrictions
    • Cookie limitations
  • Experience supporting home services or local lead-generation businesses

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are a builder first
  • Prefer shipping working systems over creating theoretical architecture
  • Understand how engineering connects to marketing performance and revenue
  • Can move comfortably between frontend, backend, APIs, CRM systems, and marketing technology
  • Troubleshoot problems independently
  • Understand attribution beyond simply installing a tracking pixel
  • Use AI practically in your development workflow
  • Work well with non-technical stakeholders such as media buyers and operators
  • Move quickly without sacrificing system reliability
  • Take ownership from problem identification through deployment

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Building a new internal tool in Next.js and React
  • Developing Python backend functionality
  • Troubleshooting Meta CAPI or Pixel tracking
  • Investigating attribution discrepancies
  • Connecting CRM conversion data to advertising platforms
  • Building or improving a marketing performance dashboard
  • Creating an AI-powered lead qualification workflow
  • Developing API or webhook integrations
  • Automating repetitive operational processes
  • Meeting with media buyers to understand campaign bottlenecks
  • Shipping improvements and monitoring their real-world impact

In short: you build the technology layer connecting advertising, leads, CRM data, AI, attribution, and revenue operations.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Internal tools successfully adopted by media buyers and operators
  • Reduced manual work across marketing and CRM workflows
  • Accurate and reliable conversion tracking
  • Improved attribution across advertising and CRM systems
  • Faster campaign reporting and operational execution
  • Reliable integrations and data flows
  • Increased automation across repetitive processes
  • AI systems delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, lead quality, or conversion

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Build systems with direct impact on marketing performance and revenue
  • Work across full-stack engineering, AI, marketing technology, and automation
  • Solve real attribution and lead-generation problems
  • High ownership over technical execution
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and performance marketing teams
  • Exposure to 150+ home service businesses and significant campaign data
  • Opportunity to build systems that become core infrastructure for a growing agency
  • Fully remote environment

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have 4–6+ years of software engineering experience
  • Are strong with Next.js, React, and Python
  • Have hands-on marketing or ad tech experience
  • Understand Meta Pixel, CAPI, attribution, and conversion tracking
  • Have built CRM integrations and lead automation workflows
  • Actively use AI in your engineering work
  • Love shipping systems that solve real business problems

We’d love to hear from you.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with full-stack development, Next.js, React, Python, marketing technology, Meta Pixel/CAPI, CRM integrations, attribution, automation, and AI-powered systems.

We recommend sharing specific examples of systems you have personally built and deployed—especially projects involving marketing data pipelines, conversion tracking, CRM automation, internal dashboards, APIs, webhooks, or AI integrations. Focus on your individual technical contribution and the measurable business impact of your work.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing U.S.-based investment management firm building institutional-quality alternative investment solutions for wealth advisors, family offices, and financial professionals. The company combines the innovation and speed of a technology startup with the sophistication of the financial services industry, creating a highly collaborative environment where talented professionals can make a meaningful impact while working directly with senior leadership.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Operations & Investment Operations Specialist to become the operational backbone of a rapidly growing investment management firm.

This is a highly cross-functional role supporting business operations, recruiting, people operations, executive support, investor relations, finance, fund operations, and AI-driven process automation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced operator who thrives in fast-paced startup environments, enjoys building scalable systems, and has a strong understanding of finance, accounting, and investment operations. Rather than simply maintaining processes, you'll continuously improve them through automation and AI while supporting critical business and fund operations.

What You'll Do

Business Operations

  • Support weekly operational reviews and quarterly business planning.
  • Develop and improve operational playbooks, documentation, and reporting.
  • Manage vendors, subscriptions, and internal business systems.

Recruiting & People Operations

  • Own recruiting coordination, interview scheduling, onboarding, and offboarding.

  • Help foster a collaborative and engaging remote culture.

Investor Relations & Executive Support

  • Manage investor communications and coordinate meetings.

  • Coordinate executive travel and strategic initiatives.
  • Track priorities and ensure timely follow-up across leadership projects.

Finance & Fund Operations

  • Support capital calls, distributions, fee calculations, and investor reporting.
  • Assist with new fund launches and operational setup.
  • Coordinate with external fund administrators and internal finance teams.

AI & Systems Optimization

  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve workflows through AI and automation.
  • Build AI-powered workflows, automations, and agents that eliminate manual work.

Sales & Marketing Support

  • Support outbound sales initiatives and communication campaigns.
  • Assist with CRM management and business development operations.

Required Qualifications

  • C2 / Near-native English proficiency.
  • 8+ years of experience in Business Operations, Operations, Chief of Staff, Finance Operations, Fund Operations, or similar cross-functional roles.
  • Previous experience working in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, including P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow.
  • Experience supporting finance operations and business processes.
  • Exceptional organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong systems thinking with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and workflow automation.
  • High level of ownership, discretion, and ability to manage confidential information.
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in investment management, asset management, capital markets, hedge funds, private equity, venture capital, wealth management, family offices, or fund administration.
  • Experience reviewing NAVs, fund accounting, investor onboarding, subscriptions, redemptions, KYC/AML, capital calls, distributions, or fund reporting.
  • Experience with accounting, financial operations, or controller support.
  • Experience building automations using Zapier, Make, AI agents, or similar platforms.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.
raw.description:
Human Interest is on a mission to ensure that people in all lines of work have access to retirement benefits.

More than half of all working Americans are not saving enough for their future. Too often, it’s because they are employed by a company that doesn’t offer a retirement plan. Human Interest is changing that by making it affordable and accessible for small and medium-sized businesses to offer employees a path to financial independence through retirement savings.

We’re a high-growth fintech company changing the retirement industry. We are backed by a number of investors. This includes funding from Marshall Wace and Baillie Gifford, as well as top investors such as BlackRock, TPG (The Rise Fund), SoftBank, Glynn Capital, NewView Capital, USVP, Wing, Uncork, and more.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build industry-first products that make retirement accounts simple and easy for employers to support and participants to use. You will collaborate with domain experts to design, build and test new features and systems. As reliability and auditability is key to earning our customers’ trust, you will build robust systems that are observable, maintainable, and scalable. As an engineering organization, we:

  • Value continuous improvement - we care about documentation, security, durability, not just throwing features over the wall.
  • Help each other be better engineers - we leave things better than we found it.
  • Aspire to collaborate seamlessly - we ensure our software is improving the customer experience.

What you get to do every day

  • Design, build, and maintain our user experiences for both external and internal customers
  • Work on business-critical, foundational services which serve as the data funnel of our entire platform
  • Improve complex processes and systems to make them more robust and require less human intervention
  • Collaborate with other engineers and stakeholders to share knowledge and build expertise
  • Develop ownership over domains in our system and make informed engineering tradeoffs
  • Advocate for and delight internal and external users
  • Direct AI agents across the full development lifecycle, from prototyping and implementation to debugging and code review. Operate as the architect and decision-maker while AI handles the building
  • Expand what's possible with AI tooling and identify opportunities to automate repetitive engineering work, improve code quality through AI-driven review, and share effective patterns with your team

What you bring to the role

  • 6+ years of experience building and maintaining software in production
  • Desire to work with the following technologies: Node, TypeScript, Kotlin, React, AWS, PostgreSQL, Kafka
  • Proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., Codex, Claude Code and Cursor) to accelerate development cycles and improve code quality.
  • Top notch communication skills. You can communicate well with engineers and non-engineers alike
  • Strong desire to learn, think creatively, and share knowledge with others
  • Enjoy mentoring other engineers and deeply review their code
  • Proactive and empathetic mindset - you love to roll up your sleeves to fix problems for our customers
  • Past experience working in startups and/or fintech

Why you will love working at Human Interest

Human Interest is tackling one of our country's biggest challenges - closing the retirement gap. You'll be instrumental in architecting and scaling solutions that bring financial security to employees at small and medium-sized businesses nationwide. We’ve made significant progress, but there is still growth ahead, offering you a unique opportunity to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and advance your career alongside a dedicated, mission-driven team. We value hard work and recognize that our team's contributions are key to our continued success.

Join Human Interest and make a lasting impact by shaping the future of retirement.

Our operating principles define how we work together as a team. They reflect Human Interest’s unique view on what’s important and what’s right. Documenting this core aspect of our culture helps employees make good decisions on their own. It also helps candidates considering career opportunities critically evaluate whether they will thrive at Human Interest.

  • Customer obsession: We're all about creating amazing experiences for our customers. We put their needs first and go the extra mile to make them smile.
  • Long-Term Orientation: We're not just playing for today; we're building a legacy. We think big, plan strategically, and invest in our future.
  • Autonomous and Accountable Teams: We trust our team members to take ownership and make smart decisions. We empower you to be your best self!
  • An Escalating Bar for Talent and Performance: We're constantly raising the bar and challenging ourselves to be better. We believe in growth and continuous improvement.
  • Fundamental Optimism: We see the glass as half full (and then we fill it up with more amazing ideas!). We believe in the power of positivity and the potential for greatness.

Compensation - At Human Interest, there are a number of factors that are used to determine the appropriate pay range for each position. We take into account the cost of labor for each position in various markets across the U.S. The base salary for this position spans $190,000 - $230,000 and represents the minimum in our lowest geographic region to a maximumin our highest geographic region. The salary we offer to a new employee within this range is based on their location within the U.S., their relevant job-related skills, and experience. At Human Interest, base salary is one component of the overall total rewards package. Depending on the position, additional compensation components such as bonuses, commissions, and equity may be offered. All of our employees are offered a robust suite of physical, financial, and mental wellness benefits. In compliance with applicable laws, we do not inquire about salary history, or about criminal history prior to a conditional offer of employment.

Benefits -

  • A great 401(k) plan: Our own! Our 401(k) includes a dollar-for-dollar employer match up to 4% of compensation (immediately vested) and $0 plan fees
  • Top-of-the-line health plans, as well as dental and vision insurance
  • Competitive time off and parental leave
  • Addition Wealth: Unlimited access to digital tools, financial professionals, and a knowledge center to help you understand your equity and support your financial wellness
  • Lyra: Enhanced Mental Health Support for Employees and dependents
  • Carrot: Fertility healthcare and family forming benefits
  • Candidly: Student loan resource to help you and your family plan, borrow, and repay student debt
  • Monthly work-from-home stipend; quarterly lifestyle stipend
  • Engaging team-building experiences, ranging from virtual social events to team offsites, promoting collaboration and camaraderie.

We’re a great place to work (but don’t take our word for it)

Here’s a list of our awards and accolades:

  • Certified as a Great Place To Work® (2023-2025)
  • Fortune Best Place to Work in the Bay Area (2024)
  • Best Places to Work by Built In (2023-2024)
  • America’s Best Startup Employers by Forbes (2020-2022, 2024)
  • A Top Company by Y Combinator (2020-2023)
  • Inc. Fastest Growing Companies (2021)

Human Interest is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran or military status, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected under federal, state, or local laws. Employment with Human Interest is at-will, meaning either you or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, except as otherwise provided by law or written agreement.
